young, free from disease, and handsomer even than Kandarpa.
She arranged their dalliance; they were unaware of day or night.

4.115.s:
sāṃprataṃ tava kanyā sā'pyūṣāgarbhavatī satī .
kulajā kulayoścaiva taptāṅgārasvarūpiṇī .. 6 ..
4.115.d:
सांप्रतं तव कन्या साऽप्यूषागर्भवती सती ।
कुलजा कुलयोश्चैव तप्ताङ्गारस्वरूपिणी ॥ 6 ॥
4.115.m:
Now that daughter of yours, Ūṣā, is pregnant, though of noble birth,
acting as a glowing ember to both families.

4.115.s:
dauhitro vā'pi dauhitrī babhuva sāṃprataṃ tava.
kanyāṃ paśya mahāprauḍhāṃ nagarīṃ nāgarānvitām .. 7 ..
4.115.d:
दौहित्रो वाऽपि दौहित्री बभुव सांप्रतं तव।
कन्यां पश्य महाप्रौढां नगरीं नागरान्विताम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.115.m:
A grandson or a granddaughter is now yours.
Look at your fully grown daughter, a city inhabited by a townsman,

4.115.s:
nakhavikṣatasarvāṅgīṃ varādhīnāṃ ca cañcalām .
puṃsaśca saṅgirīṃ śaśvadrahasye ratisaṅginīm .. 8 ..
4.115.d:
नखविक्षतसर्वाङ्गीं वराधीनां च चञ्चलाम् ।
पुंसश्च सङ्गिरीं शश्वद्रहस्ये रतिसङ्गिनीम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.115.m:
her whole body scratched with fingernails, submissive to a lover, fickle,
always accompanied by a man, indulging in lovemaking in secret!"

4.115.s:
sasmitāṃ sakaṭākṣāṃ ca ca़ñcalekṣaṇavīkṣatām .
evaṃ śrutvā lajjitaśca bāṇastatra cukopa ha .. 9 ..
4.115.d:
सस्मितां सकटाक्षां च च़ञ्चलेक्षणवीक्षताम् ।
एवं श्रुत्वा लज्जितश्च बाणस्तत्र चुकोप ह ॥ 9 ॥
4.115.m: Smiling, casting sidelong glances, observed with restless eyes—” / Having heard this, Bāṇa felt ashamed and flew into a rage right there.

4.115.s:
yuddhāya ca matiṃ cakre vāritaḥ śabhunā bhṛśam .
vāritaśca gaṇeśena skandena śivayā tathā .. 10 ..
4.115.d:
युद्धाय च मतिं चक्रे वारितः शभुना भृशम् ।
वारितश्च गणेशेन स्कन्देन शिवया तथा ॥ 10 ॥
4.115.m: And he resolved upon war, [though] strongly forbidden by Śambhu, / and forbidden by Gaṇeśa, Skanda, and likewise by Śivā,

4.115.s:
bhairavyā bhadrakālyā ca yoginībhiśca saṃtatam .
aṣṭabhirbhairavaiścaiva rudrairekādaśātmakaiḥ .. 11 ..
4.115.d:
भैरव्या भद्रकाल्या च योगिनीभिश्च संततम् ।
अष्टभिर्भैरवैश्चैव रुद्रैरेकादशात्मकैः ॥ 11 ॥
4.115.m: by Bhairavī, Bhadrakālī, and constantly by the Yoginīs, / by the eight Bhairavas, and by the Rudras eleven in number,

4.115.s:
bhūtaiḥ pretaiśca kūṣmāṇḍairvetālairbrahmarākṣasaiḥ .
yosīndrairapi siddhendrai rudraiścaṇḍādibhistathā .. 12 ..
4.115.d:
भूतैः प्रेतैश्च कूष्माण्डैर्वेतालैर्ब्रह्मराक्षसैः ।
योसीन्द्रैरपि सिद्धेन्द्रै रुद्रैश्चण्डादिभिस्तथा ॥ 12 ॥
4.115.m: by the Bhūtas, Pretas, Kūṣmāṇḍas, Vetālas, and Brahmarākṣasas, / by the foremost yogins, foremost siddhas, and likewise by the Rudras, Caṇḍa, and the rest,

4.115.s:
koṭaryā prāmadevyā ca yathā mātrā hitāya ca .
uvāca śaṃkaro bāṇaṃ mūḍhaṃ paṇḍitamāninam
hitaṃ satyaṃ nītiśāstraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham .. 13 ..
4.115.d:
कोटर्या प्रामदेव्या च यथा मात्रा हिताय च ।
उवाच शंकरो बाणं मूढं पण्डितमानिनम्
हितं सत्यं नीतिशास्त्रं परिणामसुखावहम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.115.m: and by Koṭarī, the goddess of his lineage, for his benefit like a mother. / Śaṅkara spoke to Bāṇa, who was a fool imagining himself wise, / words that were beneficial, true, in accordance with the treatises on conduct, and leading to happiness in the end:

4.115.s:
mahādeva uvāca
śṛṇu bāṇa pravakṣyāmi kathāmetāṃ purātanīm .
bhuvo bhārāvataraṇe bhārate svayamīśvaraḥ .. 14 ..
4.115.d:
महादेव उवाच
शृणु बाण प्रवक्ष्यामि कथामेतां पुरातनीम् ।
भुवो भारावतरणे भारते स्वयमीश्वरः ॥ 14 ॥
4.115.m: Mahādeva said: / Hear, Bāṇa, I shall recount this ancient narrative. / For the removal of the earth's burden, the Lord himself on Bhārata,

4.115.s:
nihatya sarvānrājendrāndvārakāyāṃ virājate .
yasya lomasu viśvāni tasya vāsaḥ sadīśvaraḥ .. 15 ..
4.115.d:
निहत्य सर्वान्राजेन्द्रान्द्वारकायां विराजते ।
यस्य लोमसु विश्वानि तस्य वासः सदीश्वरः ॥ 15 ॥
4.115.m: having slain all the foremost kings, shines forth in Dvārakā. / He in whose bodily hairs the universes [reside], who is their abode, the eternal Lord,

4.115.s:
vāsudeva iti khyātaḥ kathyate tena kovidaiḥ .
dhāturvidhātā bhagavāṃścakrapāṇiḥ svayaṃ bhuvi .. 16 ..
4.115.d:
वासुदेव इति ख्यातः कथ्यते तेन कोविदैः ।
धातुर्विधाता भगवांश्चक्रपाणिः स्वयं भुवि ॥ 16 ॥
4.115.m: is renowned as Vāsudeva; therefore he is spoken of [thus] by the wise. / The Bhagavat, the creator of the creator, holding the discus in hand, is himself on earth.

4.115.s:
brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāmīśvaraḥ prakṛteḥ paraḥ .
nirguṇaśca nirīhaśca bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ .. 17 ..
4.115.d:
ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादीनामीश्वरः प्रकृतेः परः ।
निर्गुणश्च निरीहश्च भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहः ॥ 17 ॥
4.115.m: He is the Lord of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others, beyond Prakṛti, / devoid of gunas, devoid of craving, whose body is [assumed out of] grace to his devotees,

4.115.s:
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma paramātmā ca dehinaḥ .
yasmingate śavo jīvo saṃgrāmastena saṃbhavet .. 18 ..
4.115.d:
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम परमात्मा च देहिनः ।
यस्मिन्गते शवो जीवो संग्रामस्तेन संभवेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.115.m: the Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, and the Paramātman of embodied beings, / upon whose departure the living being becomes a corpse. Could battle be joined with him?

4.115.s:
śastraviddho mahākāśo yathā mūḍha diśastathā .
tathā''tmā ca nirākāro dehī ca dhyānahetunā .. 19 ..
4.115.d:
शस्त्रविद्धो महाकाशो यथा मूढ दिशस्तथा ।
तथा'ऽत्मा च निराकारो देही च ध्यानहेतुना ॥ 19 ॥
4.115.m: As great space cannot be pierced by weapons, O fool, nor the directions, / so too the Ātman is formless, and an embodied being [assumes form] only as an object of meditation.

4.115.s:
tasya putro'niruddhaśca mahābalaparākramaḥ .
trailokyamapi saṃhartuṃ kṣaṇena ca kṣamaḥ svayam .. 20 ..
4.115.d:
तस्य पुत्रोऽनिरुद्धश्च महाबलपराक्रमः ।
त्रैलोक्यमपि संहर्तुं क्षणेन च क्षमः स्वयम् ॥ 20 ॥
4.115.m: His grandson Aniruddha is possessed of great strength and valor, / capable of destroying even the three worlds in an instant himself.

4.115.s:
sarve vevāśca daityāśca balavanto mahārathāḥ .
te sarve cāniruddhasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm .. 21 ..
4.115.d:
सर्वे वेवाश्च दैत्याश्च बलवन्तो महारथाः ।
ते सर्वे चानिरुद्धस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.115.m: All the gods and daityas, mighty chariot-warriors, / all of them are not equal to a sixteenth part of Aniruddha.

4.115.s:
yayoreva samaṃ vittaṃ yayoreva samaṃ balam .
tayorvivāho maitrī ca na tu puṣṭavipuṣṭayoḥ .. 22 ..
4.115.d:
ययोरेव समं वित्तं ययोरेव समं बलम् ।
तयोर्विवाहो मैत्री च न तु पुष्टविपुष्टयोः ॥ 22 ॥
4.115.m: Marriage and alliance take place between those two / whose wealth is equal and whose strength is equal, but not between the powerful and the powerless.

4.115.s:
baliḥ pitā te daityānāṃ sārabhūto mahārathaḥ .
kṣaṇena yena nītaśca sutalaṃ sa hareḥ kalā .. 23 ..
4.115.d:
बलिः पिता ते दैत्यानां सारभूतो महारथः ।
क्षणेन येन नीतश्च सुतलं स हरेः कला ॥ 23 ॥
4.115.m: Bali, your father, the chief among the daityas, a great chariot-warrior— / he who banished him to Sutala in an instant was a part of Hari.

4.115.s:
sarve cāṃśakalāḥ puṃsaḥ paripūrṇatamasya ca .
vṛndāvaneśvarasyāpi kṛṣṇasya paramātmanaḥ .. 24 ..
4.115.d:
सर्वे चांशकलाः पुंसः परिपूर्णतमस्य च ।
वृन्दावनेश्वरस्यापि कृष्णस्य परमात्मनः ॥ 24 ॥
4.115.m: And all beings are portions and parts of that most complete Puruṣa, / the Lord of Vṛndāvana, Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman.

4.115.s:
pārvatyuvāca
dhyāyate dhyānaniṣṭhaśca hṛtpadme ca divāniśm .
brahmā maheśaḥ meṣaśca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam .. 25 ..
4.115.d:
पार्वत्युवाच
ध्यायते ध्याननिष्ठश्च हृत्पद्मे च दिवानिश्म् ।
ब्रह्मा महेशः मेषश्च भगवन्तं सनातनम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.115.m: Pārvatī said: / Absorbed in meditation, in the lotus of the heart day and night, / Brahmā, Maheśa, and Śeṣa meditate upon the eternal Bhagavat.

4.115.s:
dineśaśca gaṇeśaśca yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ .
dhyāyate paramātmānaṃ bhagavantaṃ sanātanam .. 26 ..
4.115.d:
दिनेशश्च गणेशश्च योगीन्द्राणां गुरोर्गुरुः ।
ध्यायते परमात्मानं भगवन्तं सनातनम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.115.m: The sun-god, and Gaṇeśa, the teacher of the teachers of yogins, / meditates upon the Paramātman, the eternal Bhagavat.

4.115.s:
sanatkumāraḥ kapilo naro nārāyaṇastathā .
dhyāyate hṛdayāmbhoje bhagavantaṃ sao .. 27 ..
4.115.d:
सनत्कुमारः कपिलो नरो नारायणस्तथा ।
ध्यायते हृदयाम्भोजे भगवन्तं सओ ॥ 27 ॥
4.115.m: Sanatkumāra, Kapila, Nara, and Nārāyaṇa / meditate in the lotus of the heart upon the eternal Bhagavat.

4.115.s:
manavaśca munīndrāśca siddhendrā yogināṃ varāḥ .
dhyānāsādhyaṃ ca dhyāyante bhagavantaṃ sao .. 28 ..
4.115.d:
मनवश्च मुनीन्द्राश्च सिद्धेन्द्रा योगिनां वराः ।
ध्यानासाध्यं च ध्यायन्ते भगवन्तं सओ ॥ 28 ॥
4.115.m: The Manus, the foremost sages, the foremost siddhas, and the best of yogins / meditate upon the Bhagavat, the eternal one, unattainable even by meditation.

4.115.s:
sarvādiṃ sarvabījaṃ ca sarveśaṃ ca parātparam .
dhyāyante jñāninaḥ sarve bhagavantaṃ sao .. 29 ..
4.115.d:
सर्वादिं सर्वबीजं च सर्वेशं च परात्परम् ।
ध्यायन्ते ज्ञानिनः सर्वे भगवन्तं सओ ॥ 29 ॥
4.115.m: The beginning of all, the seed of all, the Lord of all, and higher than the highest, / upon the eternal Bhagavat do all the wise meditate.

4.115.s:
gaṇeśa uvāca
abhāgyaṃ ca baleścāpi vaiṣṇavasya mahātmanaḥ .
mūḍho'yamīdṛśaḥ putraḥ prahlādasya ca dhīmataḥ .. 30 ..
4.115.d:
गणेश उवाच
अभाग्यं च बलेश्चापि वैष्णवस्य महात्मनः ।
मूढोऽयमीदृशः पुत्रः प्रह्लादस्य च धीमतः ॥ 30 ॥
4.115.m: Gaṇeśa said: / This is the misfortune of Bali, the great-souled Vaiṣṇava, / and of the wise Prahlāda, that this fool is born as a son.

4.115.s:
skanda uvāca
aye bhrātarna śrutā ca hiraṇyakaśipoḥ kathā .
hiraṇyākṣasya ca madhoḥ kaiṭabhasya mahātmanaḥ .. 31 ..
4.115.d:
स्कन्द उवाच
अये भ्रातर्न श्रुता च हिरण्यकशिपोः कथा ।
हिरण्याक्षस्य च मधोः कैटभस्य महात्मनः ॥ 31 ॥
4.115.m: Skanda said: / Ah, brother, have you not heard the story of Hiraṇyakaśipu, / and of Hiraṇyākṣa, and of the great Madhu and Kaiṭabha?

4.115.s:
pūrvajāste'pi te daityā mahābalaparākramāḥ .
krameṇa viṣṇunā nītā līlayā yamasādanam .. 32 ..
4.115.d:
पूर्वजास्तेऽपि ते दैत्या महाबलपराक्रमाः ।
क्रमेण विष्णुना नीता लीलया यमसादनम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.115.m: Those ancestors of yours, daityas of great strength and valor, / were one after another dispatched by Viṣṇu in mere play to the abode of Yama.

4.115.s:
bhagavānyasya saṃhartā svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ .
tasya ko rakṣitā bhrātarnivartasva śubhāyaca .. 33 ..
4.115.d:
भगवान्यस्य संहर्ता स्वयं नारायणः प्रभुः ।
तस्य को रक्षिता भ्रातर्निवर्तस्व शुभायच ॥ 33 ॥
4.115.m: When the Bhagavat, Lord Nārāyaṇa himself, is someone's destroyer, / who can protect him, brother? Desist, for your own good!

4.115.s:
teṣāṃ ca vacanaṃ śrutvā tānuvācāsureśvaraḥ .
koparaktāsyanayano dhanuṣpāṇiryathā'ntakaḥ .. 34 ..
4.115.d:
तेषां च वचनं श्रुत्वा तानुवाचासुरेश्वरः ।
कोपरक्तास्यनयनो धनुष्पाणिर्यथाऽन्तकः ॥ 34 ॥
4.115.m: Hearing their words, the lord of the asuras spoke to them, / with face and eyes red with anger, bow in hand, like the god of death.

4.115.s:
bāṇa uvāca
śṛṇu mātaḥ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu tāta maheśvara .
śṛṇu bhrātargaṇapate śṛṇu bhrātaśca kārtika .. 35 ..
4.115.d:
बाण उवाच
शृणु मातः प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु तात महेश्वर ।
शृणु भ्रातर्गणपते शृणु भ्रातश्च कार्तिक ॥ 35 ॥
4.115.m: Bāṇa said: / Listen, mother, I shall speak; listen, father Maheśvara; / listen, brother Gaṇapati; and listen, brother Kārtikeya.

4.115.s:
śubhaśubhaṃ prāktanena prāṇināṃ karmiṇāṃ tathā .
kṛtakarmātiriktaṃ ca kārya keṣāṃ ca vartate .. 36 ..
4.115.d:
शुभशुभं प्राक्तनेन प्राणिनां कर्मिणां तथा ।
कृतकर्मातिरिक्तं च कार्य केषां च वर्तते ॥ 36 ॥
4.115.m: Good and bad fortune befall living beings, agents of action, according to their past deeds. / What event can occur to anyone beyond the deeds they have done?

4.115.s:
nāprāptakālo mriyate viddhaḥ śaraśatairapi .
tṛṇāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati .. 37 ..
4.115.d:
नाप्राप्तकालो म्रियते विद्धः शरशतैरपि ।
तृणाग्रेणापि संस्पृष्टः प्राप्तकालो न जीवति ॥ 37 ॥
4.115.m: One whose time has not arrived does not die, even if pierced by hundreds of arrows; / but touched even by the tip of a blade of grass, one whose time has arrived does not live.

4.115.s:
yasmācca yasya nirvāṇaṃ vidhātrā likhitaṃ purā .
tadeva nityaṃ satyaṃ ca niṣekaḥ kena vāryate .. 38 ..
4.115.d:
यस्माच्च यस्य निर्वाणं विधात्रा लिखितं पुरा ।
तदेव नित्यं सत्यं च निषेकः केन वार्यते ॥ 38 ॥
4.115.m: That death which has been written beforehand by the Creator for someone, / that alone is eternal and true; who can prevent destiny?

4.115.s:
saṃgrāme kātaro yo hi niṣphalaṃ tasya jīvanam .
jayī yaśasca labhate mṛtaḥ svargaṃ ca gacchati .. 39 ..
4.115.d:
संग्रामे कातरो यो हि निष्फलं तस्य जीवनम् ।
जयी यशस्च लभते मृतः स्वर्गं च गच्छति ॥ 39 ॥
4.115.m: He who is cowardly in battle, his life is fruitless. / The victor attains fame, and if killed, he goes to heaven.

4.115.s:
praviśya kanyāṃ gṛhṇāti nagaraṃ śivarakṣitam .
pārvatyā ca gaṇeśena yuddhena balinā tathā .. 40 ..
4.115.d:
प्रविश्य कन्यां गृह्णाति नगरं शिवरक्षितम् ।
पार्वत्या च गणेशेन युद्धेन बलिना तथा ॥ 40 ॥
4.115.m: Entering the city protected by Śiva, by Pārvatī, by Gaṇeśa, / and by mighty forces, someone takes my maiden!

4.115.s:
ko vā gṛhṇāti kanyāṃ ca kasya vā jīvitasya ca .
sagarbhā tava kanyeti sabhāyāṃ rakṣako vadet .. 41 ..
4.115.d:
को वा गृह्णाति कन्यां च कस्य वा जीवितस्य च ।
सगर्भा तव कन्येति सभायां रक्षको वदेत् ॥ 41 ॥
4.115.m: Who indeed would take the maiden, and what kind of life would he keep, / when a guard says in the assembly, ‘Your maiden is pregnant’?

4.115.s:
iti me vajratulyaṃ ca śrutikauṭaṃ paraṃ vacaḥ .
ato'nirudvaṃ hatvā ca ghātayiṣyāmi kanyakām
anyathā jvaladagnau ca tyakṣyāmi ca kalevaram .. 42 ..
4.115.d:
इति मे वज्रतुल्यं च श्रुतिकौटं परं वचः ।
अतोऽनिरुद्वं हत्वा च घातयिष्यामि कन्यकाम्
अन्यथा ज्वलदग्नौ च त्यक्ष्यामि च कलेवरम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.115.m: Such words are like a thunderbolt to me, exceedingly harsh to the ears. / Therefore, after slaying Aniruddha, I will kill the maiden, / or else I shall surrender my body into blazing fire.

4.115.s:
koṭaryuvāca
śṛṇu vatsa pravakṣyāmi mātā'haṃ te'pi dharmataḥ .
turantenāpi pṛtreṇa pitrorduḥrkha pade pade .. 43 ..
4.115.d:
कोटर्युवाच
शृणु वत्स प्रवक्ष्यामि माताऽहं तेऽपि धर्मतः ।
तुरन्तेनापि पृत्रेण पित्रोर्दुःर्ख पदे पदे ॥ 43 ॥
4.115.m: Koṭarī said: / Listen, child, I shall speak; I am your mother by sacred law. / By an intractable son, sorrow is caused to parents at every step.

4.115.s:
kanyā paragṛhītā sā'pyanyasmai dātumakṣamā .
śrīkṛṣṇasyāpi pautrāya pradyumnasya sutāya ca .. 44 ..
4.115.d:
कन्या परगृहीता साऽप्यन्यस्मै दातुमक्षमा ।
श्रीकृष्णस्यापि पौत्राय प्रद्युम्नस्य सुताय च ॥ 44 ॥
4.115.m: The maiden has been taken by another; she cannot be given to anyone else. / To the grandson of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the son of Pradyumna,

4.115.s:
aniruddhāya mahate svecchayā dehi kanyakām .
pūto'si bhārate varṣe saptabhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha .. 45 ..
4.115.d:
अनिरुद्धाय महते स्वेच्छया देहि कन्यकाम् ।
पूतोऽसि भारते वर्षे सप्तभिः पितृभिः सह ॥ 45 ॥
4.115.m: to the mighty Aniruddha, give the maiden of your own free will. / You will become purified in Bhāratavarṣa along with seven generations of ancestors.

4.115.s:
yautukaṃ dehi sarvasvaṃ yaśase mahase bhuvi .
anyathā raṇamadhye ca tvāṃ haniṣyati mādhavaḥ .. 46 ..
4.115.d:
यौतुकं देहि सर्वस्वं यशसे महसे भुवि ।
अन्यथा रणमध्ये च त्वां हनिष्यति माधवः ॥ 46 ॥
4.115.m: Give all your wealth as a dowry for fame and glory on earth. / Otherwise, in the midst of battle, Mādhava will slay you.

4.115.s:
sudaśaṃnena cakeṇa ko vā tvāṃ rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ .
koṭarīvacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa daityapuṃgavaḥ .. 47 ..
4.115.d:
सुदशंनेन चकेण को वा त्वां रक्षितुं क्षमः ।
कोटरीवचनं श्रुत्वा चुकोप दैत्यपुंगवः ॥ 47 ॥
4.115.m: Who indeed will be able to protect you from the Sudarśana discus? / Hearing Koṭarī's words, the foremost among daityas flew into a rage.

4.115.s:
prayayau rathamāruhya yatra pautro harermune .
skandaḥ senāpatirbhūtvā prayayau śaṃkarājñayā .. 48 ..
4.115.d:
प्रययौ रथमारुह्य यत्र पौत्रो हरेर्मुने ।
स्कन्दः सेनापतिर्भूत्वा प्रययौ शंकराज्ञया ॥ 48 ॥
4.115.m: Mounting his chariot, he went where the grandson of Hari was, O sage. / Skanda, having become the commander of the army, set forth by Śaṅkara's command.

4.115.s:
bāṇaḥ svastyayanaṃ cakre gaṇeśaśca śivaḥ svayam .
bāṇaṃ śubhāśiṣaṃ cakre pārvatī koṭarī tathā .. 49 ..
4.115.d:
बाणः स्वस्त्ययनं चक्रे गणेशश्च शिवः स्वयम् ।
बाणं शुभाशिषं चक्रे पार्वती कोटरी तथा ॥ 49 ॥
4.115.m: Gaṇeśa and Śiva himself performed rites of auspiciousness for Bāṇa; / Pārvatī and likewise Koṭarī bestowed auspicious blessings upon Bāṇa.

4.115.s:
aṣṭau ca bhairavāścaiva rudrāścaikādaśaiva te .
sarve yuddhāya hantāro babhūvuḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ .. 50 ..
4.115.d:
अष्टौ च भैरवाश्चैव रुद्राश्चैकादशैव ते ।
सर्वे युद्धाय हन्तारो बभूवुः शस्त्रपाणयः ॥ 50 ॥
4.115.m: The eight Bhairavas and the eleven Rudras, / all of them became slayers ready for battle, weapons in hand.

4.115.s:
etasminnantare dūto'pyaniruddhamuvāca ha .
pārvatyā preritaścaiva bāṇapatnyā ca satvaram .. 51 ..
4.115.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे दूतोऽप्यनिरुद्धमुवाच ह ।
पार्वत्या प्रेरितश्चैव बाणपत्न्या च सत्वरम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.115.m: In the meantime, a messenger sent by Pārvatī / and by Bāṇa's wife spoke quickly to Aniruddha.

4.115.s:
dūta uvāca
aniruddhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ pārvatīvacanaṃ śṛṇu .
bhava sāṃnāhiko vatsa kuru yuddhaṃ bahirbhava .. 52 ..
4.115.d:
दूत उवाच
अनिरुद्धोत्तिष्ठ भद्रं पार्वतीवचनं शृणु ।
भव सांनाहिको वत्स कुरु युद्धं बहिर्भव ॥ 52 ॥
4.115.m: The messenger said: / Arise, Aniruddha! Good fortune to you! Hear the words of Pārvatī: / Arm yourself, my child, fight, and go outside!

4.115.s:
bhītoṣā rudatī trastā sasmāra pārvatīṃ satīm .
rakṣa rakṣa mahāmāye matpraṇeśvaramīpsitam .. 53 ..
4.115.d:
भीतोषा रुदती त्रस्ता सस्मार पार्वतीं सतीम् ।
रक्ष रक्ष महामाये मत्प्रणेश्वरमीप्सितम् ॥ 53 ॥
4.115.m: Frightened, weeping, and terrified, Uṣā remembered the virtuous Pārvatī: / 'Protect, protect, O Mahāmāyā, the beloved lord of my life!

4.115.s:
abheye'pyabhayaṃ dehi saṃgrāme ghoradāruṇe .
tvameva jagatāṃ mātā snehaste sarvataḥ samaḥ .. 54 ..
4.115.d:
अभेयेऽप्यभयं देहि संग्रामे घोरदारुणे ।
त्वमेव जगतां माता स्नेहस्ते सर्वतः समः ॥ 54 ॥
4.115.m: O grantor of safety, grant safety even in this terrible, dread battle! / You alone are the mother of the worlds; your love is equal to all.'

4.115.s:
athāniruddhaḥ saṃnāhī śastrapāṇirbabhūva ha .
ūṣādattaṃ rathaṃ prāpya cakārā''rohaṇaṃ mudā .. 55 ..
4.115.d:
अथानिरुद्धः संनाही शस्त्रपाणिर्बभूव ह ।
ऊषादत्तं रथं प्राप्य चकारा'ऽरोहणं मुदा ॥ 55 ॥
4.115.m: Then Aniruddha armed himself, weapon in hand; / mounting the chariot given by Uṣā, he ascended it with joy.

4.115.s:
bahiḥ saṃbhūya śibirāddadarśa bāṇamīśvaraḥ .
sāṃnāhikaṃ śastrapāṇiṃ raktāsyalocanaṃ param .. 56 ..
4.115.d:
बहिः संभूय शिबिराद्ददर्श बाणमीश्वरः ।
सांनाहिकं शस्त्रपाणिं रक्तास्यलोचनं परम् ॥ 56 ॥
4.115.m: Going forth from the camp, the powerful hero saw Bāṇa / clad in armour, weapon in hand, his face and eyes utterly blood-red.

4.115.s:
dṛṣṭvā'niruddhaṃ bāṇaśca tamuvāca ruṣā'nvitaḥ .
ghorasaṃgrāmamadhye ca viṣoktiṃ prajvalanniva .. 57 ..
4.115.d:
दृष्ट्वाऽनिरुद्धं बाणश्च तमुवाच रुषाऽन्वितः ।
घोरसंग्राममध्ये च विषोक्तिं प्रज्वलन्निव ॥ 57 ॥
4.115.m: Seeing Aniruddha, Bāṇa, filled with fury, / spoke words of venom to him in the midst of the dread battle, as if blazing with fire.

4.115.s:
bāṇa uvāca
aye vīra mahāduṣṭa nītiśāstravivarjita .
candra vaṃśakulāṅgāra puṇyakṣetre'yaśaskara .. 58 ..
4.115.d:
बाण उवाच
अये वीर महादुष्ट नीतिशास्त्रविवर्जित ।
चन्द्र वंशकुलाङ्गार पुण्यक्षेत्रेऽयशस्कर ॥ 58 ॥
4.115.m: Bāṇa said: / 'Hey warrior, utterly wicked one, devoid of the science of polity, / coal of the lunar lineage, bringer of disgrace to the sacred land!

4.115.s:
pitā te śambaraṃ hatvā jagrāha tasya kāminīm .
tato jāto bhavaneva nirodhaṃ svakulakṣamam .. 59 ..
4.115.d:
पिता ते शम्बरं हत्वा जग्राह तस्य कामिनीम् ।
ततो जातो भवनेव निरोधं स्वकुलक्षमम् ॥ 59 ॥
4.115.m: Your father killed Śambara and seized his woman; / born from him, you yourself bring restraint and ruin upon your own family.

4.115.s:
pitāmaho vāsudevo mathurāyāṃ ca kṣatriyaḥ .
gokule vaiśyaputraśca nāmnā ca nandanandanaḥ .. 60 ..
4.115.d:
पितामहो वासुदेवो मथुरायां च क्षत्रियः ।
गोकुले वैश्यपुत्रश्च नाम्ना च नन्दनन्दनः ॥ 60 ॥
4.115.m: Your grandfather is Vāsudeva—a kṣatriya in Mathurā, / and a vaiśya’s son in Gokula, called by the name of Nanda’s son.

4.115.s:
vṛndāvane ca gopasya nandasya paśurakṣakaḥ .
sākṣājjāraśca gopīnāṃ duṣṭaḥ paramalampaṭaḥ .. 61 ..
4.115.d:
वृन्दावने च गोपस्य नन्दस्य पशुरक्षकः ।
साक्षाज्जारश्च गोपीनां दुष्टः परमलम्पटः ॥ 61 ॥
4.115.m: And in Vṛndāvana, a keeper of cattle for the cowherd Nanda, / a manifest paramour of the cowherd women, wicked and utterly lustful!

4.115.s:
jaghāna pūtanāṃ sadyo nārīghātī hyadhārmikaḥ .
āgatya mathurāṃ kubjāṃ jaghāna maithunena ca .. 62 ..
4.115.d:
जघान पूतनां सद्यो नारीघाती ह्यधार्मिकः ।
आगत्य मथुरां कुब्जां जघान मैथुनेन च ॥ 62 ॥
4.115.m: He immediately slew Pūtanā—a killer of women, unrighteous indeed! / Coming to Mathurā, he killed the hunchback woman by sexual intercourse.

4.115.s:
durbalaṃ narakaṃ hatvā strīsamūhaṃ manoharam .
jagrāha yonilubdhaśca svaputramatiniṣṭhuraḥ .. 63 ..
4.115.d:
दुर्बलं नरकं हत्वा स्त्रीसमूहं मनोहरम् ।
जग्राह योनिलुब्धश्च स्वपुत्रमतिनिष्ठुरः ॥ 63 ॥
4.115.m: Having slain the weak Naraka, his own son, that utterly cruel one, / greedy for women, seized his host of charming wives.

4.115.s:
bhīṣmakaṃ mānavaṃ jitvā tatputraṃ cāpi durbalam .
jagrāha kanyakāṃ tasya devayogyāṃ ca rukmiṇīm .. 64 ..
4.115.d:
भीष्मकं मानवं जित्वा तत्पुत्रं चापि दुर्बलम् ।
जग्राह कन्यकां तस्य देवयोग्यां च रुक्मिणीम् ॥ 64 ॥
4.115.m: Conquering the mortal Bhīṣmaka and his weak son as well, / he seized his maiden Rukmiṇī, who was fit for the gods.

4.115.s:
satrājitaḥ sūryabhṛtyo devātprāpa maṇīśvaram .
ghātayitvā hyupāyena jagrāha maṇikanyakām .. 65 ..
4.115.d:
सत्राजितः सूर्यभृत्यो देवात्प्राप मणीश्वरम् ।
घातयित्वा ह्युपायेन जग्राह मणिकन्यकाम् ॥ 65 ॥
4.115.m: Satrājit, a servant of the Sun, obtained the supreme jewel from the god; / having caused him to be slain by a trick, [Kṛṣṇa] seized the jewel and the maiden.

4.115.s:
kurupāṇḍavayuddhaṃ ca kārayitvā ca dāruṇam .
yudhiṣṭhirasya yajñe ca śiśupālaṃ jaghāna saḥ .. 66 ..
4.115.d:
कुरुपाण्डवयुद्धं च कारयित्वा च दारुणम् ।
युधिष्ठिरस्य यज्ञे च शिशुपालं जघान सः ॥ 66 ॥
4.115.m: Having brought about the terrible battle between the Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas, / he slew Śiśupāla at the sacrifice of Yudhiṣṭhira.

4.115.s:
dantavaktraṃ ca śālbaṃ ca jarāsaṃdhaṃ ca dāruṇaḥ .
saṃjahāra bhuvo bhūpasamūhamatidāruṇam .. 67 ..
4.115.d:
दन्तवक्त्रं च शाल्बं च जरासंधं च दारुणः ।
संजहार भुवो भूपसमूहमतिदारुणम् ॥ 67 ॥
4.115.m: Cruel, he destroyed Dantavaktra, Śālva, and Jarāsaṃdha, / and a mighty host of the earth's kings.

4.115.s:
upāyānnarakaṃ hatvā sarvasvaṃ tajjahāra saḥ .
durbalo rājabhītaścasamudraṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 68 ..
4.115.d:
उपायान्नरकं हत्वा सर्वस्वं तज्जहार सः ।
दुर्बलो राजभीतश्चसमुद्रं शरणं गतः ॥ 68 ॥
4.115.m: Having slain Naraka by deceit, he seized all his wealth; / weak and terrified of kings, he fled for refuge to the ocean.

4.115.s:
jitvā ca bhrātaraṃ śakraṃ bhāryāyā vacanena ca .
jagrāha pārijātaṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca svargadurlabham .. 69 ..
4.115.d:
जित्वा च भ्रातरं शक्रं भार्याया वचनेन च ।
जग्राह पारिजातं च पुष्पं च स्वर्गदुर्लभम् ॥ 69 ॥
4.115.m: And defeating his brother Śakra at the word of his wife, / he seized the pārijāta flower, rare even in heaven.

4.115.s:
kaṃsaṃ nihatyādharmiṣṭho bhrātaraṃ mātureva ca .
jagrāha tasya sarvasvaṃ paraṃ kiṃ kathayāmi te .. 70 ..
4.115.d:
कंसं निहत्याधर्मिष्ठो भ्रातरं मातुरेव च ।
जग्राह तस्य सर्वस्वं परं किं कथयामि ते ॥ 70 ॥
4.115.m: Most unrighteous, he struck down Kaṃsa, the very brother of his mother, / and seized all his wealth; what more shall I say to you?

4.115.s:
jatvā ca bhallukaṃ yuddhe jagrāha tasya kanyakām .
tatpiturbhaginī kuntī caturṇāṃ kāminī bhuvi .. 71 ..
4.115.d:
जत्वा च भल्लुकं युद्धे जग्राह तस्य कन्यकाम् ।
तत्पितुर्भगिनी कुन्ती चतुर्णां कामिनी भुवि ॥ 71 ॥
4.115.m: And conquering a bear in battle, he took his maiden daughter. / His father’s sister Kuntī was the woman of four men on earth,

4.115.s:
draupadī bhrātṛpatnī ca pa़ñcānāṃ kāminī tathā .
goṣṭhīno yonilubdhaśca śaśvatparamalampaṭaḥ .. 72 ..
4.115.d:
द्रौपदी भ्रातृपत्नी च प़ञ्चानां कामिनी तथा ।
गोष्ठीनो योनिलुब्धश्च शश्वत्परमलम्पटः ॥ 72 ॥
4.115.m: and Draupadī, his brother’s wife, was likewise the woman of five. / His family is greedy for women, constantly and utterly dissolute!

4.115.s:
tajjyeṣṭho baradevaśca śaśvatpibati vāruṇīm .
yamunāṃ bhrātṛpatnīṃ ca karotyāhvānamīpsitam .. 73 ..
4.115.d:
तज्ज्येष्ठो बरदेवश्च शश्वत्पिबति वारुणीम् ।
यमुनां भ्रातृपत्नीं च करोत्याह्वानमीप्सितम् ॥ 73 ॥
4.115.m: His elder brother Baladeva constantly drinks wine, / and passionately summons Yamunā, his brother’s wife!

4.115.s:
jahāra bhaginīṃ tasya kauḥteyaḥ śakranandanaḥ .
subhadrāṃ mātulasutāṃ saṃnibodha kulakramam .. 74 ..
4.115.d:
जहार भगिनीं तस्य कौःतेयः शक्रनन्दनः ।
सुभद्रां मातुलसुतां संनिबोध कुलक्रमम् ॥ 74 ॥
4.115.m: The son of Kuntī, son of Śakra, carried off his sister Subhadrā, / his maternal uncle’s daughter—understand your family lineage!'

4.115.s:
bāṇasya vacanaṃ śrutvā cukopa kāmanandanaḥ .
uvāca paramārthaṃ ca yogyaṃ pratyuttaraṃ mune .. 75 ..
4.115.d:
बाणस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा चुकोप कामनन्दनः ।
उवाच परमार्थं च योग्यं प्रत्युत्तरं मुने ॥ 75 ॥
4.115.m: Hearing Bāṇa’s speech, the son of Kāma was enraged, / and spoke the highest truth as a fitting reply, O sage.

4.115.s:
aniruddha uvāca
pitā me kāmadevaśca brahmaputraḥ purā śuciḥ .
yasyāstreṇa vaśībhūtaṃ trailokyaṃ satataṃ śṛṇu .. 76 ..
4.115.d:
अनिरुद्ध उवाच
पिता मे कामदेवश्च ब्रह्मपुत्रः पुरा शुचिः ।
यस्यास्त्रेण वशीभूतं त्रैलोक्यं सततं शृणु ॥ 76 ॥
4.115.m: Aniruddha said: / 'My father is Kāmadeva, formerly pure, the son of Brahmā, / by whose weapon the three worlds are ever subdued—listen!

4.115.s:
śivakopānalenaiva bhasmībhūtaḥ svakarmataḥ .
kṛṣṇasya putro'pyadhunā sarveṣāṃ paramātmanaḥ .. 77 ..
4.115.d:
शिवकोपानलेनैव भस्मीभूतः स्वकर्मतः ।
कृष्णस्य पुत्रोऽप्यधुना सर्वेषां परमात्मनः ॥ 77 ॥
4.115.m: Though reduced to ashes by the fire of Śiva’s wrath according to his own action, / he is now the son of Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman of all.

4.115.s:
pativratā ratirmātā patiśokena sāṃpratam .
śambarasya gṛhe tasthau hṛtā tena balena ca .. 78 ..
4.115.d:
पतिव्रता रतिर्माता पतिशोकेन सांप्रतम् ।
शम्बरस्य गृहे तस्थौ हृता तेन बलेन च ॥ 78 ॥
4.115.m: My devoted mother Rati, grieving for her husband, / then stayed in Śambara’s house, having been abducted by him by force.

4.115.s:
chāyāṃ māyāvatīṃ dattvā māyayā śayanena ca .
ratiṃ svadharma saṃrakṣya dharmasākṣī ca tadgṛhe .. 79 ..
4.115.d:
छायां मायावतीं दत्त्वा मायया शयनेन च ।
रतिं स्वधर्म संरक्ष्य धर्मसाक्षी च तद्गृहे ॥ 79 ॥
4.115.m: Giving the illusory Māyāvatī by her power of illusion to his bed, / Rati preserved her own virtue, with Dharma as witness in his house.

4.115.s:
nihatya śambaraṃ śatruṃ gṛhītvā svapriyāṃ satīm .
ājagāma dvārakāṃ ca candrasuryau ca sākṣiṇau .. 80 ..
4.115.d:
निहत्य शम्बरं शत्रुं गृहीत्वा स्वप्रियां सतीम् ।
आजगाम द्वारकां च चन्द्रसुर्यौ च साक्षिणौ ॥ 80 ॥
4.115.m: Slaying the enemy Śambara and taking his virtuous beloved, / [my father] came to Dvārakā, with the sun and moon as witnesses.

4.115.s:
pitāmahaṃ vāsudevaṃ tvaṃ kiṃ jānāmi mūḍhavat .
yaṃ ca santona jānanti vedāścatvāra eva ca .. 81 ..
4.115.d:
पितामहं वासुदेवं त्वं किं जानामि मूढवत् ।
यं च सन्तोन जानन्ति वेदाश्चत्वार एव च ॥ 81 ॥
4.115.m: Do you, like a fool, think you understand my grandfather Vāsudeva, / whom even the good and the four Vedas do not know?

4.115.s:
vāsuḥ sarvanivāsaśca viśvāni yasya lomasu .
tasya devaḥ paraṃ brahma vāsudeva iti smṛtaḥ .. 82 ..
4.115.d:
वासुः सर्वनिवासश्च विश्वानि यस्य लोमसु ।
तस्य देवः परं ब्रह्म वासुदेव इति स्मृतः ॥ 82 ॥
4.115.m: “Vāsu” means the abode of all, in whose bodily hairs the universes reside; / that God, the supreme Brahman, is remembered as Vāsudeva.

4.115.s:
śaṃkaraṃ pṛccha sākṣācca yasya bhṛtyo'dhunā bhavān .
kṛṣṇabhṛtyasya ca baleḥ putro'si kiṃkarātmajaḥ .. 83 ..
4.115.d:
शंकरं पृच्छ साक्षाच्च यस्य भृत्योऽधुना भवान् ।
कृष्णभृत्यस्य च बलेः पुत्रोऽसि किंकरात्मजः ॥ 83 ॥
4.115.m: Ask Śaṅkara himself, whose servant you are now! / You are the son of Bali, the servant of Kṛṣṇa—you are the son of a servant!

4.115.s:
gokule vaiśyaputratvaṃ brūhi tvaṃ jñānadurbala .
bhojanaṃ vedavihitaṃ śaśvatkṣattriyavaiśyayoḥ .. 84 ..
4.115.d:
गोकुले वैश्यपुत्रत्वं ब्रूहि त्वं ज्ञानदुर्बल ।
भोजनं वेदविहितं शश्वत्क्षत्त्रियवैश्ययोः ॥ 84 ॥
4.115.m: Speak not of his being a vaiśya’s son in Gokula, you weak in knowledge! / Dining together is prescribed by the Veda always for kṣatriyas and vaiśyas.

4.115.s:
droṇaḥ prajāpatiḥ śreṣṭhā dharā tasya priyā satī .
putraṃ ca tapasā lebhe paramātmānamīśvaram .. 85 ..
4.115.d:
द्रोणः प्रजापतिः श्रेष्ठा धरा तस्य प्रिया सती ।
पुत्रं च तपसा लेभे परमात्मानमीश्वरम् ॥ 85 ॥
4.115.m: Droṇa was a Prajāpati, and the noble Dharā his beloved, chaste wife; / through austerity she obtained as her son the Lord, the Paramātman.

4.115.s:
droṇo nando vaiśyarājo yaśodā sā dharā satī .
vṛṣabhānasutā rādhā sudāmnaḥ śāpakāraṇāt .. 86 ..
4.115.d:
द्रोणो नन्दो वैश्यराजो यशोदा सा धरा सती ।
वृषभानसुता राधा सुदाम्नः शापकारणात् ॥ 86 ॥
4.115.m: Droṇa became Nanda, the king of vaiśyas, and that virtuous Dharā became Yaśodā; / Rādhā, daughter of Vṛṣabhānu, came because of the curse of Sudāman.

4.115.s:
triṃśatkoṭiṃ ca gopīnāṃ gṛhītvā bharturājñayā .
puṇyaṃ ca bhārataṃ kṣetraṃ golokādājagāmasā .. 87 ..
4.115.d:
त्रिंशत्कोटिं च गोपीनां गृहीत्वा भर्तुराज्ञया ।
पुण्यं च भारतं क्षेत्रं गोलोकादाजगामसा ॥ 87 ॥
4.115.m: Taking thirty crores of cowherd women by the command of her husband, / she came from Goloka to the sacred land of Bhārata.

4.115.s:
tābhiḥ sārdha sa reme ca svapatnībhirmudā'nvitaḥ .
pāṇiṃ jagrāha rādhāyāḥ svayaṃ brahmā purohitaḥ .. 88 ..
4.115.d:
ताभिः सार्ध स रेमे च स्वपत्नीभिर्मुदाऽन्वितः ।
पाणिं जग्राह राधायाः स्वयं ब्रह्मा पुरोहितः ॥ 88 ॥
4.115.m: With them, his own wives, he sported with joy; / Brahmā himself was the priest who joined Rādhā’s hand [in marriage].

4.115.s:
gopakoṭiśca golokādājagām mṛdā'nvitā .
tejasā haritulyāste pārṣadapravarā hareḥ .. 89 ..
4.115.d:
गोपकोटिश्च गोलोकादाजगाम् मृदाऽन्विता ।
तेजसा हरितुल्यास्ते पार्षदप्रवरा हरेः ॥ 89 ॥
4.115.m: And a crore of cowherds came joyfully from Goloka; / in splendour they were equal to Hari, the foremost attendants of Hari.

4.115.s:
gorakṣaṇaṃ harereva gopaveṣasya cā''tmanaḥ .
gopānāṃ śiśurakṣārthaṃ māyeśasyāpi māyayā .. 90 ..
4.115.d:
गोरक्षणं हरेरेव गोपवेषस्य चा'ऽत्मनः ।
गोपानां शिशुरक्षार्थं मायेशस्यापि मायया ॥ 90 ॥
4.115.m: The tending of cattle was performed by Hari Himself disguised as a cowherd, / by the illusion of the Lord of Illusion, in order to protect the children of the cowherds.

4.115.s:
pūtanā balikanyā ca bhaginī ca tavāsura .
dṛṣṭvā ca vāmanaṃ vindhyā cakāra putramānasam .. 91 ..
4.115.d:
पूतना बलिकन्या च भगिनी च तवासुर ।
दृष्ट्वा च वामनं विन्ध्या चकार पुत्रमानसम् ॥ 91 ॥
4.115.m: Pūtanā was the daughter of Bali and your sister, O asura! / Beholding the dwarf incarnation, Vindhyā formed the desire for a son:

4.115.s:
evaṃbhūto yadi mama putro bhavati sāṃpratam .
stanaṃ dadāmi tanayaṃ kṛtvā vakṣasi sundaram .. 92 ..
4.115.d:
एवंभूतो यदि मम पुत्रो भवति सांप्रतम् ।
स्तनं ददामि तनयं कृत्वा वक्षसि सुन्दरम् ॥ 92 ॥
4.115.m: “If such a child should now become my son, / I would hold the handsome boy to my breast and give him my breast[milk].”

4.115.s:
tasyāḥpūrṇaṃ mānasaṃ ca cakāra bhagavānprabhuḥ .
stanaṃ dattvā ca golokaṃ yayau sā ratnayānataḥ .. 93 ..
4.115.d:
तस्याःपूर्णं मानसं च चकार भगवान्प्रभुः ।
स्तनं दत्त्वा च गोलोकं ययौ सा रत्नयानतः ॥ 93 ॥
4.115.m: The Lord, the Sovereign, fulfilled her heart’s desire; / after giving her breast, she went to Goloka in a vehicle of jewels.

4.115.s:
kubjā sā bhaginī pūrvaṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ .
śrīrāmaṃ cakame kāmānnāmnā śūrpaṇakhā satī .. 94 ..
4.115.d:
कुब्जा सा भगिनी पूर्वं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।
श्रीरामं चकमे कामान्नाम्ना शूर्पणखा सती ॥ 94 ॥
4.115.m: The hunchback woman was formerly the sister of the wicked Rāvaṇa, / named Śūrpaṇakhā, who out of passion desired the venerable Rāma.

4.115.s:
nāsāṃ ciccheda tasyāśca lakṣmaṇo dhārmikeśvaraḥ .
tapasā ca varaṃ lebhe brahmaṇaḥ priyamīśvaram .. 95 ..
4.115.d:
नासां चिच्छेद तस्याश्च लक्ष्मणो धार्मिकेश्वरः ।
तपसा च वरं लेभे ब्रह्मणः प्रियमीश्वरम् ॥ 95 ॥
4.115.m: Lakṣmaṇa, the lord of the righteous, cut off her nose; / and through austerity she obtained a boon from Brahmā: the Lord, her beloved.

4.115.s:
tena puṇyena taṃlabdhvā golokaṃ sā jagāma ha .
gopī babhūva goloke kṛṣṇasyā''liṅganena ca .. 96 ..
4.115.d:
तेन पुण्येन तंलब्ध्वा गोलोकं सा जगाम ह ।
गोपी बभूव गोलोके कृष्णस्या'ऽलिङ्गनेन च ॥ 96 ॥
4.115.m: Having obtained him by that merit, she went indeed to Goloka; / and through Kṛṣṇa's embrace she became a gopī in Goloka. 96

4.115.s:
narako harivadhyaśca svapūrvaprāktanena ca .
pāṇiṃ jagrāha kanyānāṃ sākṣiṇau śaśibhāskarau .. 97 ..
4.115.d:
नरको हरिवध्यश्च स्वपूर्वप्राक्तनेन च ।
पाणिं जग्राह कन्यानां साक्षिणौ शशिभास्करौ ॥ 97 ॥
4.115.m: And Naraka was to be slain by Hari because of his own past deeds. / He took the hands of the maidens, with the sun and moon as witnesses. 97

4.115.s:
bhīṣmakanyā mahālakṣmīḥ śīkṛṣṇasya priyā satī .
vaikuṇṭhādāgatā sādhvī brahmaṇo'nṛmatena ca .. 98 ..
4.115.d:
भीष्मकन्या महालक्ष्मीः शीकृष्णस्य प्रिया सती ।
वैकुण्ठादागता साध्वी ब्रह्मणोऽनृमतेन च ॥ 98 ॥
4.115.m: The daughter of Bhīṣmaka, Mahālakṣmī, was Śrī Kṛṣṇa's beloved, devoted wife; / the virtuous woman had come from Vaikuṇṭha with the approval of Brahmā. 98

4.115.s:
satrājitasya kanyā sā satyabhāmā vasuṃdhara .
dadau kṛṣṇāya rājā sa taṃ maṇiṃ yautukena ca .. 99 ..
4.115.d:
सत्राजितस्य कन्या सा सत्यभामा वसुंधर ।
ददौ कृष्णाय राजा स तं मणिं यौतुकेन च ॥ 99 ॥
4.115.m: Satyabhāmā, the daughter of Satrājit, was the Earth; / and that king gave that jewel to Kṛṣṇa as a dowry. 99

4.115.s:
bhuvo bhārāvataraṇahetunā gamanaṃ hareḥ .
saṃjahāra bhuvo bhāraṃ kurupāṇḍavayuddhataḥ .. 100 ..
4.115.d:
भुवो भारावतरणहेतुना गमनं हरेः ।
संजहार भुवो भारं कुरुपाण्डवयुद्धतः ॥ 100 ॥
4.115.m: Hari's departure was for the purpose of removing the burden of the earth; / he removed the burden of the earth through the battle between the Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas. 100

4.115.s:
śiśupālo dantavaktro jayo vijaya eva ca .
dvāriṇau dvāraṣaṭke ca vaikuṇṭhe śrīharerapi .. 101 ..
4.115.d:
शिशुपालो दन्तवक्त्रो जयो विजय एव च ।
द्वारिणौ द्वारषट्के च वैकुण्ठे श्रीहरेरपि ॥ 101 ॥
4.115.m: Śiśupāla and Dantavaktra were indeed Jaya and Vijaya, / the two doorkeepers at the six gateways in Vaikuṇṭha of Śrī Hari. 101

4.115.s:
kumāraśāpātpatitau prāpya janmatrayaṃ dhruvam .
hiraṇyakaśipuścaiva tavaiva pūrvapūruṣaḥ .. 102 ..
4.115.d:
कुमारशापात्पतितौ प्राप्य जन्मत्रयं ध्रुवम् ।
हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव तवैव पूर्वपूरुषः ॥ 102 ॥
4.115.m: Having fallen by the curse of the Kumāras, they inevitably underwent three births; / and Hiraṇyakaśipu was indeed your own ancestor. 102

4.115.s:
tasya bhrātā hiraṇyākṣastenaiva varuṇo jitaḥ .
harirnṛsiṃharūpeṇa taṃ jaghānāvalīlayā .. 103 ..
4.115.d:
तस्य भ्राता हिरण्याक्षस्तेनैव वरुणो जितः ।
हरिर्नृसिंहरूपेण तं जघानावलीलया ॥ 103 ॥
4.115.m: His brother was Hiraṇyākṣa, by whom Varuṇa was conquered; / Hari, in the form of Nṛsiṃha, effortlessly slew him [Hiraṇyakaśipu]. 103

4.115.s:
sūkareṇa hato'nyaśca pūrvajanmakathāṃ śṛṇu .
dvitīye janmani purā rāvaṇaḥ kumbhakarṇakaḥ .. 104 ..
4.115.d:
सूकरेण हतोऽन्यश्च पूर्वजन्मकथां शृणु ।
द्वितीये जन्मनि पुरा रावणः कुम्भकर्णकः ॥ 104 ॥
4.115.m: And the other was slain by the Boar; hear the story of their earlier birth. / Formerly, in their second birth, they were Rāvaṇa and Kumbhakarṇa. 104

4.115.s:
śrīrāmeṇa hatau tau dvau śeṣajanma kalau tayoḥ .
śrīkṛṣṇena hatau tau dvau dharmaputrāvubhau tathā .. 105 ..
4.115.d:
श्रीरामेण हतौ तौ द्वौ शेषजन्म कलौ तयोः ।
श्रीकृष्णेन हतौ तौ द्वौ धर्मपुत्रावुभौ तथा ॥ 105 ॥
4.115.m: Those two were slain by Śrī Rāma; their final birth is in the Kali age. / Those two were slain by Śrī Kṛṣṇa, and likewise both [became] sons of Dharma. 105

4.115.s:
jarāsaṃdhaśca śālvaśca durātmā kaṃsa eva ca .
prāktanāttasya vadhyāste bhuvo bhārajihīrṣayā .. 106 ..
4.115.d:
जरासंधश्च शाल्वश्च दुरात्मा कंस एव च ।
प्राक्तनात्तस्य वध्यास्ते भुवो भारजिहीर्षया ॥ 106 ॥
4.115.m: Jarāsaṃdha, Śālva, and the evil Kaṃsa— / because of their past deeds they were to be slain by him, desiring to remove the burden of the earth. 106

4.115.s:
māṃdhātuḥ sutamadhye ca yavanaścāpi prāktanāt .
lakṣmīśvarasya kṛṣṇasya dhanena kiṃ prayojanamā .. 107 ..
4.115.d:
मांधातुः सुतमध्ये च यवनश्चापि प्राक्तनात् ।
लक्ष्मीश्वरस्य कृष्णस्य धनेन किं प्रयोजनमा ॥ 107 ॥
4.115.m: And among the sons of Māndhātṛ, the Yavana also [died] due to past deeds. / What need is there of wealth for Kṛṣṇa, the lord of Lakṣmī? 107

4.115.s:
pratijñayā ca satyāyāḥ puṇyakavratakāraṇāt .
pārijātaṃ samanīya cakāra svātmano vratam .. 108 ..
4.115.d:
प्रतिज्ञया च सत्यायाः पुण्यकव्रतकारणात् ।
पारिजातं समनीय चकार स्वात्मनो व्रतम् ॥ 108 ॥
4.115.m: And in accordance with Satyā's vow, for the sake of the Puṇyaka observance, / he brought the Pārijāta tree and performed his own vow. 108

4.115.s:
svayaṃ jāmbavatī devī durgāṃśā bhallukātmajā .
pāṇiṃ jagrāha tasyāśca tapasā bhārate hariḥ .. 109 ..
4.115.d:
स्वयं जाम्बवती देवी दुर्गांशा भल्लुकात्मजा ।
पाणिं जग्राह तस्याश्च तपसा भारते हरिः ॥ 109 ॥
4.115.m: The goddess Jāmbavatī herself, the daughter of the bear, was an aṃśa of Durgā; / and Hari took her hand in Bhārata by virtue of her asceticism. 109

4.115.s:
kuntyāśca kṣetrajāḥ putrāḥ kevalaṃ bharturājñayā .
kalau niṣiddhaṃ triyuge prasiddhaṃ palapaitṛkam .. 110 ..
4.115.d:
कुन्त्याश्च क्षेत्रजाः पुत्राः केवलं भर्तुराज्ञया ।
कलौ निषिद्धं त्रियुगे प्रसिद्धं पलपैतृकम् ॥ 110 ॥
4.115.m: And Kuntī's sons were born of the field solely by the command of her husband. / The offering of meat to the ancestors is celebrated in three yugas, but forbidden in the Kali age. 110

4.115.s:
yudhiṣṭhiro dharmaputro bhīmaśca pavanātmajaḥ .
mahendraputro dharmiṣṭhaḥ phālguno vijayī bhuvi .. 111 ..
4.115.d:
युधिष्ठिरो धर्मपुत्रो भीमश्च पवनात्मजः ।
महेन्द्रपुत्रो धर्मिष्ठः फाल्गुनो विजयी भुवि ॥ 111 ॥
4.115.m: Yudhiṣṭhira was the son of Dharma, Bhīma the son of the wind god, / and the most righteous Phālguna, victorious on earth, was the son of Mahendra, 111

4.115.s:
yasmai pāśupataṃ śaṃbhuḥ pradadau ca svayaṃ purā .
aśvamedhaṃ gavālambhaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ palapaitṛkam .. 112 ..
4.115.d:
यस्मै पाशुपतं शंभुः प्रददौ च स्वयं पुरा ।
अश्वमेधं गवालम्भं संन्यासं पलपैतृकम् ॥ 112 ॥
4.115.m: to whom Śambhu himself formerly gave the Pāśupata weapon. / The horse sacrifice, the slaughter of cows, renunciation, the offering of meat to the ancestors, 112

4.115.s:
devareṇa sutotpattiṃ kalau pañca vivarjayet .
draupadyāḥ pañca bhartāraḥ śaṃkarasya vareṇa ca .. 113 ..
4.115.d:
देवरेण सुतोत्पत्तिं कलौ पञ्च विवर्जयेत् ।
द्रौपद्याः पञ्च भर्तारः शंकरस्य वरेण च ॥ 113 ॥
4.115.m: and the begetting of sons by a brother-in-law: one should avoid these five in the Kali age. / Draupadī had five husbands through the boon of Śaṅkara. 113

4.115.s:
baladevaḥ puṣpamadhu pūtaṃ pibati nityaśaḥ .
cakāra yamunāhvānaṃ snānārthaṃ dhārmikaḥ śuciḥ .. 114 ..
4.115.d:
बलदेवः पुष्पमधु पूतं पिबति नित्यशः ।
चकार यमुनाह्वानं स्नानार्थं धार्मिकः शुचिः ॥ 114 ॥
4.115.m: Baladeva constantly drinks pure flower-wine; / the righteous and pure one summoned the Yamunā for the purpose of bathing. 114

4.115.s:
subhadrāṃ ca dadau kṛṣṇaḥ phālgunāya mahātmane .
kanyakāṃ mātulānāṃ ca dākṣiṇātyaḥ parigrahaḥ .. 115 ..
4.115.d:
सुभद्रां च ददौ कृष्णः फाल्गुनाय महात्मने ।
कन्यकां मातुलानां च दाक्षिणात्यः परिग्रहः ॥ 115 ॥
4.115.m: And Kṛṣṇa gave Subhadrā to the great-souled Phālguna; / marriage with the daughter of maternal uncles is a southern custom. 115

4.115.s:
deśeṣvanyeṣu doṣo'yamityāha kamalodbhavaḥ .. 116 ..
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo vāṇāniruddhasaṃo
pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 115 ..
4.115.d:
देशेष्वन्येषु दोषोऽयमित्याह कमलोद्भवः ॥ 116 ॥
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ वाणानिरुद्धसंओ
पञ्चदशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ॥ 115 ॥
4.115.m:
In other countries this is a fault: thus said the lotus-born [Brahmā]. 116
Thus ends the one hundred and fifteenth chapter, in the dialogue of Bāṇa and Aniruddha, in the dialogue of Nārada and Nārāyaṇa, in the Uttarakhaṇḍa of the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa in the great Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa. 115

4.116.s:
bāṇa uvāca
aniruddha budho'si tvaṃ tvayoktaṃ satyameva ca .
śaṃbhunā caivamuktaṃ ca sarvaṃ buddhaṃ svacetasā .. 1 ..
4.116.d:
बाण उवाच
अनिरुद्ध बुधोऽसि त्वं त्वयोक्तं सत्यमेव च ।
शंभुना चैवमुक्तं च सर्वं बुद्धं स्वचेतसा ॥ 1 ॥

4.116.s:
tvayoktaṃ śaṃkaravarātpañcānāṃ svāmināṃ priyā .
draupadī ca mahābhāgā tanme vyākhyātumarhasi .. 2 ..
4.116.d:
त्वयोक्तं शंकरवरात्पञ्चानां स्वामिनां प्रिया ।
द्रौपदी च महाभागा तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥ 2 ॥
4.116.m: You said that by the boon of Śaṅkara, the highly fortunate Draupadī / became dear to five husbands; you ought to explain that to me. 2

4.116.s:
śambareṇa hṛtā pūrva tava mātā kathaṃ ratiḥ .
devairapi kathaṃ dattā devāstena jitā katham .. 3 ..
4.116.d:
शम्बरेण हृता पूर्व तव माता कथं रतिः ।
देवैरपि कथं दत्ता देवास्तेन जिता कथम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.116.m: How was your mother, Rati, formerly abducted by Śambara? / And how was she given by the gods, and how were the gods conquered by him? 3

4.116.s:
aniruddha uvāca
ekadā raghunāthaśca sītayā lakṣmaṇo ca .
snātaḥ sarasi tatrastho ramye pañcavaṭītaṭe .. 4 ..
4.116.d:
अनिरुद्ध उवाच
एकदा रघुनाथश्च सीतया लक्ष्मणो च ।
स्नातः सरसि तत्रस्थो रम्ये पञ्चवटीतटे ॥ 4 ॥
4.116.m: Aniruddha said: / Once the lord of the Raghus, with Sītā and Lakṣmaṇa, / bathed in a lake situated there on the delightful bank of Pañcavaṭī. 4

4.116.s:
uvāca sītā hemante jalaṃ susvādu nirmalam .
tathā'nnaṃ vyañjanaṃ ramyaṃ sarvaṃ vastu suśītalam .. 5 ..
4.116.d:
उवाच सीता हेमन्ते जलं सुस्वादु निर्मलम् ।
तथाऽन्नं व्यञ्जनं रम्यं सर्वं वस्तु सुशीतलम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.116.m: In winter Sītā said: "The water is very sweet and clear, / and the cooked food and sauce are delightful; every item is very cold." 5

4.116.s:
phalāvabacayanaṃ cakre sītāyai pradadau mudā .
tato dadau lakṣmaṇāya paścādbhaṅkte svayaṃ prabhuḥ .. 6 ..
4.116.d:
फलावबचयनं चक्रे सीतायै प्रददौ मुदा ।
ततो ददौ लक्ष्मणाय पश्चाद्भङ्क्ते स्वयं प्रभुः ॥ 6 ॥
4.116.m: He gathered fruits and gladly gave them to Sītā; / then he gave to Lakṣmaṇa, and afterwards the lord ate himself. 6

4.116.s:
lakṣmaṇastadgṛhītvā ca naiva bhuṅkte phalaṃ jalam .
meghanādavadhārthaṃ ca sītoddhāraṇakāraṇāt .. 7 ..
4.116.d:
लक्ष्मणस्तद्गृहीत्वा च नैव भुङ्क्ते फलं जलम् ।
मेघनादवधार्थं च सीतोद्धारणकारणात् ॥ 7 ॥
4.116.m: Lakṣmaṇa took that, but did not eat fruit or drink water at all, / for the sake of slaying Meghanāda and for the rescue of Sītā. 7

4.116.s:
nidrāṃ na yāti no bhuṅkte varṣāṇāṃ ca caturdaśa .
ya evaṃ puruṣo yogī tadvadhyo rāvaṇatmajaḥ .. 8 ..
4.116.d:
निद्रां न याति नो भुङ्क्ते वर्षाणां च चतुर्दश ।
य एवं पुरुषो योगी तद्वध्यो रावणत्मजः ॥ 8 ॥
4.116.m: He did not sleep and did not eat for fourteen years; / the son of Rāvaṇa was to be slain only by such a man who is a yogi. 8

4.116.s:
etasminnantare rāmaṃ draṣṭuṃ kamalalocanam .
vahanistatra samāyāto dvijarūpī kṛpānidhiḥ
bhaviṣyatkathayāmāma śrutikauṭaparaṃ vacaḥ .. 9 ..
4.116.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामं द्रष्टुं कमललोचनम् ।
वहनिस्तत्र समायातो द्विजरूपी कृपानिधिः
भविष्यत्कथयामाम श्रुतिकौटपरं वचः ॥ 9 ॥
4.116.m: In the meantime, the fire god, an ocean of compassion in the form of a twice-born, / arrived there to see lotus-eyed Rāma, / and spoke words foretelling the future, conforming to the secret of the Vedas. 9

4.116.s:
vahniruvāca
śṛṇu rāma mahābhāga sītāsaṃgopanaṃ kuru .
saptāhābhyantare caiva rāvaṇo duṣṭarākṣasaḥ .. 10 ..
4.116.d:
वह्निरुवाच
शृणु राम महाभाग सीतासंगोपनं कुरु ।
सप्ताहाभ्यन्तरे चैव रावणो दुष्टराक्षसः ॥ 10 ॥
4.116.m: The fire god said: / Listen, highly fortunate Rāma: conceal Sītā. / Within seven days the wicked rākṣasa Rāvaṇa, 10

4.116.s:
durnivāryaḥ prāktanena jānakīṃ ca hariṣyati .
vidhātrā likhitaṃ karma prāktaṃnaṃ kena vāryate .. 11 ..
4.116.d:
दुर्निवार्यः प्राक्तनेन जानकीं च हरिष्यति ।
विधात्रा लिखितं कर्म प्राक्तंनं केन वार्यते ॥ 11 ॥
4.116.m: hard to restrain due to past deeds, will abduct Jānakī. / Past deeds are written by the Creator; by whom can they be averted? 11

4.116.s: vedaiścaturbhiḥ kathitaṃ na ca daivātparaṃ varam .. 12 ..
4.116.d: वेदैश्चतुर्भिः कथितं न च दैवात्परं वरम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.116.m: It is stated by the four Vedas that there is no superior boon to destiny. 12

4.116.s:
rāma uvāca
sītāṃ gṛhītvā tvaṃ gaccha cchāyā'traiva tu tiṣṭhatu .
kalatravarjanaṃ karma sarveṣāṃ ca jugupsitam .. 13 ..
4.116.d:
राम उवाच
सीतां गृहीत्वा त्वं गच्छ च्छायाऽत्रैव तु तिष्ठतु ।
कलत्रवर्जनं कर्म सर्वेषां च जुगुप्सितम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.116.m: Rāma said: / Taking Sītā, go, but let her shadow remain right here. / The act of abandoning a wife is censured by all. 13

4.116.s:
sītāṃ gṛhītvā prayayau rudatīṃ ca hutāśanaḥ .
sītayā sadṛśī chāyā tasthau śrīrāmasaṃnidhau .. 14 ..
4.116.d:
सीतां गृहीत्वा प्रययौ रुदतीं च हुताशनः ।
सीतया सदृशी छाया तस्थौ श्रीरामसंनिधौ ॥ 14 ॥
4.116.m: Taking the weeping Sītā, the fire god departed. / A shadow resembling Sītā remained in the presence of Śrī Rāma. 14

4.116.s:
sā ca cchāyā hṛtā pūrva rāvaṇenāvalīlayā .
samuddadhāra tāṃ rāmo nihatya taṃ sabāndhavam .. 15 ..
4.116.d:
सा च च्छाया हृता पूर्व रावणेनावलीलया ।
समुद्दधार तां रामो निहत्य तं सबान्धवम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.116.m: And that shadow was previously abducted effortlessly by Rāvaṇa; / having slain him along with his kinsmen, Rāma rescued her. 15

4.116.s:
vahnau parīkṣākāle ca cchāyā vahnau viveśa sā .
agniśchāyāṃ ca saṃrakṣya dadau rāmāya jānakīm .. 16 ..
4.116.d:
वह्नौ परीक्षाकाले च च्छाया वह्नौ विवेश सा ।
अग्निश्छायां च संरक्ष्य ददौ रामाय जानकीम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.116.m: And at the time of the fire ordeal, that shadow entered the fire; / Agni, having preserved the shadow, gave Jānakī back to Rāma. 16

4.116.s:
rāmastāṃ ca gṛhītvā ca prayayau svāśramaṃ mudā .
chāyā tasthau vahnipārśve hṛdayena vidūyatā .. 17 ..
4.116.d:
रामस्तां च गृहीत्वा च प्रययौ स्वाश्रमं मुदा ।
छाया तस्थौ वह्निपार्श्वे हृदयेन विदूयता ॥ 17 ॥
4.116.m: Rāma took her and went to his hermitage with joy; / the shadow remained by the side of the fire with an aching heart. 17

4.116.s:
sā ca cchāyā tapaścakre nārāyaṇasarovare .
tapaścakāra divyaṃ ca śātavarṣaṃ ca śūlinaḥ .. 18 ..
4.116.d:
सा च च्छाया तपश्चक्रे नारायणसरोवरे ।
तपश्चकार दिव्यं च शातवर्षं च शूलिनः ॥ 18 ॥
4.116.m: And that shadow performed asceticism at the lake of Nārāyaṇa; / she performed divine asceticism for a hundred years to the bearer of the trident. 18

4.116.s:
varaṃ vṛṇuṣva bhadre tvamuvāca śaṃkaraśca tām .
uvāca śivaṃ vyagrā bharturduḥkhena duḥkhitā .. 19 ..
4.116.d:
वरं वृणुष्व भद्रे त्वमुवाच शंकरश्च ताम् ।
उवाच शिवं व्यग्रा भर्तुर्दुःखेन दुःखिता ॥ 19 ॥
4.116.m: Śaṅkara said to her: "Choose a boon, auspicious one!" / Agitated and distressed with grief for a husband, she said to Śiva: 19

4.116.s:
patiṃ dehi pañcadhā sā varaṃ vavre trilocanam .
sarvasaṃpatpradastuṣṭastasyai śarvo varaṃ dadau .. 20 ..
4.116.d:
पतिं देहि पञ्चधा सा वरं वव्रे त्रिलोचनम् ।
सर्वसंपत्प्रदस्तुष्टस्तस्यै शर्वो वरं ददौ ॥ 20 ॥
4.116.m: "Give me a husband!" Five times she asked a boon from the three-eyed one. / Śarva, bestower of all prosperity, being pleased, granted her a boon. 20

4.116.s:
mahādeva uvāca
sādhvi tvaṃ pañcadhā brūhi patiṃ dehīti vyākulā .
pañcendrāśca hareraṃśā bhaviṣyanti priyāstava .. 21 ..
4.116.d:
महादेव उवाच
साध्वि त्वं पञ्चधा ब्रूहि पतिं देहीति व्याकुला ।
पञ्चेन्द्राश्च हरेरंशा भविष्यन्ति प्रियास्तव ॥ 21 ॥
4.116.m: Mahādeva said: / Virtuous woman, agitated, you said five times: "Give me a husband!" / Five Indras, portions of Hari, will become your beloveds. 21

4.116.s:
te ca sarve ca pañcendrāścādhunā pañca pāṇḍavāḥ .
sā ca cchāyā draupadī ca yajñakuṇḍasamudbhavā .. 22 ..
4.116.d:
ते च सर्वे च पञ्चेन्द्राश्चाधुना पञ्च पाण्डवाः ।
सा च च्छाया द्रौपदी च यज्ञकुण्डसमुद्भवा ॥ 22 ॥
4.116.m: And all those five Indras are now the five Pāṇḍavas; / and that shadow is Draupadī, born from the sacrificial altar. 22

4.116.s:
kṛtayuge vedavatī tretāyāṃ janakātmajā .
dvāpare draupadī chāyā tena kṛṣṇā trihāyaṇī .. 23 ..
4.116.d:
कृतयुगे वेदवती त्रेतायां जनकात्मजा ।
द्वापरे द्रौपदी छाया तेन कृष्णा त्रिहायणी ॥ 23 ॥
4.116.m: In the Kṛta Yuga she was Vedavatī, in the Tretā the daughter of Janaka, / and in the Dvāpara she was Draupadī, the shadow; therefore Kṛṣṇā existed in the three ages.

4.116.s:
vaiṣṇapī kṛṣṇabhaktā ca tena kṛṣṇā prakīrtitā .
svargalakṣmīrmahendrāṇāṃ sā ca paścādbhaviṣyati .. 24 ..
4.116.d:
वैष्णपी कृष्णभक्ता च तेन कृष्णा प्रकीर्तिता ।
स्वर्गलक्ष्मीर्महेन्द्राणां सा च पश्चाद्भविष्यति ॥ 24 ॥
4.116.m: She was a Vaiṣṇava woman and devoted to Kṛṣṇa, therefore she was proclaimed as Kṛṣṇā; / and later she will become the Svargalakṣmī of the great Indras.

4.116.s:
rājā dadau phālgunāya kanyāyāśca svayaṃvare .
papraccha mātaraṃ vīro vastu prāptaṃ mayā'dhunā .. 25 ..
4.116.d:
राजा ददौ फाल्गुनाय कन्यायाश्च स्वयंवरे ।
पप्रच्छ मातरं वीरो वस्तु प्राप्तं मयाऽधुना ॥ 25 ॥
4.116.m: The king gave her to Phālguna at the maiden's svayaṃvara; / the hero asked his mother: 'An object has now been obtained by me.'

4.116.s:
tamuvāca svayaṃ mātā gṛhāṇa bhrātṛbhiḥ saha .
śaṃbhorvareṇa pūrva ca paratra māturājñayā .. 26 ..
4.116.d:
तमुवाच स्वयं माता गृहाण भ्रातृभिः सह ।
शंभोर्वरेण पूर्व च परत्र मातुराज्ञया ॥ 26 ॥
4.116.m: His mother herself said to him: 'Accept it together with your brothers.' / Previously by Śambhu's boon, and subsequently by his mother's command,

4.116.s:
draupadyāḥ svāminastena hetunā pañca pāṇḍavāḥ .
caturdaśānāmindrāṇāṃ pañcendrāḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ .. 27 ..
4.116.d:
द्रौपद्याः स्वामिनस्तेन हेतुना पञ्च पाण्डवाः ।
चतुर्दशानामिन्द्राणां पञ्चेन्द्राः पञ्च पाण्डवाः ॥ 27 ॥
4.116.m: for that reason the five Pāṇḍavas became the husbands of Draupadī. / Among the fourteen Indras, the five Pāṇḍavas were five Indras.

4.116.s:
śaṃkareṇābhisaṃśaptā sā mātrā bhartsitena ca .
bhartāte bhasmasādbhūto harakopānalena ca .. 28 ..
4.116.d:
शंकरेणाभिसंशप्ता सा मात्रा भर्त्सितेन च ।
भर्ताते भस्मसाद्भूतो हरकोपानलेन च ॥ 28 ॥
4.116.m: She was cursed by Śaṅkara, who had been rebuked by her mother: / 'Your husband has been reduced to ashes by the fire of Hara's anger.

4.116.s:
he rati tvaṃ mayā śaptā daityagrastā bhavādhunā .
vijityadevānsendrāśca śambarastvā hariṣyati .. 29 ..
4.116.d:
हे रति त्वं मया शप्ता दैत्यग्रस्ता भवाधुना ।
विजित्यदेवान्सेन्द्राश्च शम्बरस्त्वा हरिष्यति ॥ 29 ॥
4.116.m: O Rati, you are cursed by me; now be seized by a daitya! / Having conquered the gods together with Indra, Śambara will abduct you.'

4.116.s:
punaruvataṃ varaṃ prādātsatītvāṃ te na yāsyati .
chāyāṃ dattvā tiṣṭha gehe yāvajjīvati te patiḥ .. 30 ..
4.116.d:
पुनरुवतं वरं प्रादात्सतीत्वां ते न यास्यति ।
छायां दत्त्वा तिष्ठ गेहे यावज्जीवति ते पतिः ॥ 30 ॥
4.116.m: He gave her a boon again: 'Your chastity will not be lost. / Leave a shadow and dwell in the house as long as your husband lives.'

4.116.s:
iti te kathitaṃ sarvamitihāsaṃ purātanam .
devānāṃ guptacaritaṃ śrṛṇu daityendra sāṃpratam .. 31 ..
4.116.d:
इति ते कथितं सर्वमितिहासं पुरातनम् ।
देवानां गुप्तचरितं श्रृणु दैत्येन्द्र सांप्रतम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.116.m: Thus all the ancient history has been told to you. / Now hear, O lord of daityas, the secret conduct of the gods.

4.116.s:
etasminnantare tatra subhadraśca mahābalaḥ .
kumbhāṇḍabhrātā balavānbāṇasenāpatīśvaraḥ .. 32 ..
4.116.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र सुभद्रश्च महाबलः ।
कुम्भाण्डभ्राता बलवान्बाणसेनापतीश्वरः ॥ 32 ॥
4.116.m: In the meantime, the mighty Subhadra was there, / the powerful brother of Kumbhāṇḍa and supreme commander of Bāṇa's army.

4.116.s:
nirbhatsarya bāṇaṃ samare śastrapāṇirmahārathaḥ .
śrīkṛṣṇapautraṃ śūlaṃ ca cikṣepa pralayāgnivat .. 33 ..
4.116.d:
निर्भत्सर्य बाणं समरे शस्त्रपाणिर्महारथः ।
श्रीकृष्णपौत्रं शूलं च चिक्षेप प्रलयाग्निवत् ॥ 33 ॥
4.116.m: Having censured Bāṇa in battle, the great car-warrior, weapon in hand, / hurled a trident like the fire of universal dissolution at the grandson of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

4.116.s:
ardhayandreṇa tacchūlaṃ ciccheda kāmaputrakaḥ .
śaktiṃ cikṣepa bhadraśca śatasūryasamaprabhām .. 34 ..
4.116.d:
अर्धयन्द्रेण तच्छूलं चिच्छेद कामपुत्रकः ।
शक्तिं चिक्षेप भद्रश्च शतसूर्यसमप्रभाम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.116.m: The son of Kāma cut down that trident with a crescent arrow; / and Bhadra hurled a lance blazing like a hundred suns.

4.116.s:
vaiṣṇavāstreṇa ciccheda tāṃ śaktiṃ kāmaputrakaḥ .
nārāyaṇāstraṃ cikṣepa subhadro raṇamūrdhani .. 35 ..
4.116.d:
वैष्णवास्त्रेण चिच्छेद तां शक्तिं कामपुत्रकः ।
नारायणास्त्रं चिक्षेप सुभद्रो रणमूर्धनि ॥ 35 ॥
4.116.m: The son of Kāma severed that lance with the Vaiṣṇava missile; / then Subhadra discharged the Nārāyaṇa missile at the front of the battle.

4.116.s:
praṇamya śete nirbhīto madanasya suto balī .
ūrdhvamastraṃ ca babhrāma śatasūryasamaprabham .. 36 ..
4.116.d:
प्रणम्य शेते निर्भीतो मदनस्य सुतो बली ।
ऊर्ध्वमस्त्रं च बभ्राम शतसूर्यसमप्रभम् ॥ 36 ॥
4.116.m: Bowing down, the powerful son of Madana lay fearless; / the missile, blazing like a hundred suns, circled upward.

4.116.s:
pralīnamastramākāśe viśvasaṃhārakāraṇam .
astre gate so'niruddho gṛhītvā ca mahānasim .. 37 ..
4.116.d:
प्रलीनमस्त्रमाकाशे विश्वसंहारकारणम् ।
अस्त्रे गते सोऽनिरुद्धो गृहीत्वा च महानसिम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.116.m: The missile, the cause of the destruction of the universe, dissolved into the sky. / When the missile had gone, Aniruddha, seizing a great sword,

4.116.s:
prababhañjabhadrarathaṃ jaghānāśvāṃśca sārathim .
jaghāna taṃ subhadraṃ ca līlayā raṇamūrdhani .. 38 ..
4.116.d:
प्रबभञ्जभद्ररथं जघानाश्वांश्च सारथिम् ।
जघान तं सुभद्रं च लीलया रणमूर्धनि ॥ 38 ॥
4.116.m: smashed Bhadra's chariot and slew his horses and charioteer; / and with ease he slew Subhadra at the front of the battle.

4.116.s:
hate subhadre bāṇaśca mahābalaparākramaḥ .
vāṇānāṃ śatakaṃ cāpi cakṣepa raṇamūrdhani .. 39 ..
4.116.d:
हते सुभद्रे बाणश्च महाबलपराक्रमः ।
वाणानां शतकं चापि चक्षेप रणमूर्धनि ॥ 39 ॥
4.116.m: When Subhadra was slain, Bāṇa, of great strength and valour, / also discharged a hundred arrows at the front of the battle.

4.116.s:
kāmātmajo'gnibāṇena bāṇodhaṃ pradadāha saḥ .
bāṇaścikṣepa brahmāstraṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇam .. 40 ..
4.116.d:
कामात्मजोऽग्निबाणेन बाणोधं प्रददाह सः ।
बाणश्चिक्षेप ब्रह्मास्त्रं सृष्टिसंहारकारणम् ॥ 40 ॥
4.116.m: The son of Kāma burned up the volley of arrows with a fire arrow; / Bāṇa discharged the Brahmāstra, the cause of the destruction of creation.

4.116.s:
dṛṣṭvā kāmātmajaḥ śīghraṃ sabījaṃ mantrapūrvakam .
brahmastreṇaiva sahasā saṃjahārāvalīlayā .. 41 ..
4.116.d:
दृष्ट्वा कामात्मजः शीघ्रं सबीजं मन्त्रपूर्वकम् ।
ब्रह्मस्त्रेणैव सहसा संजहारावलीलया ॥ 41 ॥
4.116.m: Seeing it, the son of Kāma quickly, with its seed-syllable and preceded by mantra, / straightway withdrew it with ease by means of the Brahmāstra itself.

4.116.s:
bāṇaḥ pāśupataṃ kṣeptuṃ samārebhe ca kopataḥ .
niṣiddhaśca gaṇeśena skandena śaṃbhunā tathā .. 42 ..
4.116.d:
बाणः पाशुपतं क्षेप्तुं समारेभे च कोपतः ।
निषिद्धश्च गणेशेन स्कन्देन शंभुना तथा ॥ 42 ॥
4.116.m: Bāṇa began out of wrath to discharge the Pāśupata; / but he was forbidden by Gaṇeśa, by Skanda, and likewise by Śambhu.

4.116.s:
taddṛṣṭvā so'niruddhastaṃ dhanurbāṇaugha saṃyutam .
mumoca jṛmbhaṇe yuddhe śīghraṃ taṃ ca mahāratham .. 43 ..
4.116.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा सोऽनिरुद्धस्तं धनुर्बाणौघ संयुतम् ।
मुमोच जृम्भणे युद्धे शीघ्रं तं च महारथम् ॥ 43 ॥
4.116.m: Seeing that he had a bow together with a mass of arrows, Aniruddha / quickly discharged the stupor-weapon upon that great car-warrior in battle.

4.116.s:
jaḍo babhūva bāṇaśca niśceṣṭo raṇamūrdhani .
punaścikṣepa nidrāsyaṃ nidritaṃ taṃ cakāra saḥ .. 44 ..
4.116.d:
जडो बभूव बाणश्च निश्चेष्टो रणमूर्धनि ।
पुनश्चिक्षेप निद्रास्यं निद्रितं तं चकार सः ॥ 44 ॥
4.116.m: Bāṇa became inert and motionless at the front of the battle; / then he discharged a sleep-inducing weapon, and put him to sleep.

4.116.s:
bāṇaṃ taṃ nidritaṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhītvā khaḍgamuttamam .
bāṇaṃ hantuṃ samudyantaṃ vārayāmāsa kārtikaḥ .. 45 ..
4.116.d:
बाणं तं निद्रितं दृष्ट्वा गृहीत्वा खड्गमुत्तमम् ।
बाणं हन्तुं समुद्यन्तं वारयामास कार्तिकः ॥ 45 ॥
4.116.m: Seeing Bāṇa asleep, Aniruddha seized an excellent sword / and was preparing to slay Bāṇa, when Kārtika held him back.

4.116.s:
skandaśca śatabāṇauśca vārayāmāsa līlayā .
aniruddhaṃ mahābhāgaṃ balavāntaṃ dhanurdharam .. 46 ..
4.116.d:
स्कन्दश्च शतबाणौश्च वारयामास लीलया ।
अनिरुद्धं महाभागं बलवान्तं धनुर्धरम् ॥ 46 ॥
4.116.m: Skanda, with a hundred arrows, held back with ease / the highly fortunate, powerful archer Aniruddha.

4.116.s:
aniruddhaśca sahasā tathā śaktyā duratyayā .
babhañja kārtikarathaṃ ratnendrasāranirmitam .. 47 ..
4.116.d:
अनिरुद्धश्च सहसा तथा शक्त्या दुरत्यया ।
बभञ्ज कार्तिकरथं रत्नेन्द्रसारनिर्मितम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.116.m: And Aniruddha suddenly, with an irresistible lance, / smashed Kārtika's chariot made from the essence of best gems.

4.116.s:
gadayā kārtikaḥ kruddho'pyaniruddharayaṃ mudā .
babhañja līlayā tatra kṣaṇena raṇamūrdhani .. 48 ..
4.116.d:
गदया कार्तिकः क्रुद्धोऽप्यनिरुद्धरयं मुदा ।
बभञ्ज लीलया तत्र क्षणेन रणमूर्धनि ॥ 48 ॥
4.116.m: Though enraged, Kārtika with his mace joyfully smashed / Aniruddha's chariot with ease in an instant there at the front of the battle.

4.116.s:
aniruddho'rdhacandreṇa kṣuradhāreṇa līlayā .
ciccheda kārtikadhanurbhallāstreṇa niyojitam .. 49 ..
4.116.d:
अनिरुद्धोऽर्धचन्द्रेण क्षुरधारेण लीलया ।
चिच्छेद कार्तिकधनुर्भल्लास्त्रेण नियोजितम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.116.m: With a razor-sharp crescent arrow Aniruddha playfully / cut through Kārtika's bow fitted with a spear-tipped missile.

4.116.s:
jadhāna kārtikastaṃ ca gadayā ca durantayā .
gadāṃ jagrāha taddhastājjavena madanātmajaḥ .. 50 ..
4.116.d:
जधान कार्तिकस्तं च गदया च दुरन्तया ।
गदां जग्राह तद्धस्ताज्जवेन मदनात्मजः ॥ 50 ॥
4.116.m: Kārtika struck him with an unbearable mace; / the son of Madana swiftly snatched the mace from his hand.

4.116.s:
śūlaṃ gṛhītvā skandaṃ ca tameva hantumu dyatam .
aniruddhaśca kopena prerayāmāsa dūrataḥ .. 51 ..
4.116.d:
शूलं गृहीत्वा स्कन्दं च तमेव हन्तुमु द्यतम् ।
अनिरुद्धश्च कोपेन प्रेरयामास दूरतः ॥ 51 ॥
4.116.m: When Skanda, seizing a trident, rose up to slay him, / Aniruddha in anger flung him far away.

4.116.s:
kārtikaḥ punarāgatya gṛhītvā kāmaputrakam .
gṛhītvā ca kareṇaiva pātayāmāsa bhūtale .. 52 ..
4.116.d:
कार्तिकः पुनरागत्य गृहीत्वा कामपुत्रकम् ।
गृहीत्वा च करेणैव पातयामास भूतले ॥ 52 ॥
4.116.m: Kārtika, coming back, seized the son of Kāma, / and grasping him with his hand, cast him to the ground.

4.116.s:
aniruddho gṛhītvā'siṃ prabhustasthau mahābalaḥ .
tayorvirodhaṃ dūraṃ ca pracakāra gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 53 ..
4.116.d:
अनिरुद्धो गृहीत्वाऽसिं प्रभुस्तस्थौ महाबलः ।
तयोर्विरोधं दूरं च प्रचकार गणेश्वरः ॥ 53 ॥
4.116.m: Grasping his sword, the powerful lord Aniruddha stood firm; / Gaṇeśvara then put an end to the hostility between the two.

4.116.s:
kārtikaḥ prayayau gehamūṣāgehaṃ smarātmajaḥ .
sarva nivedituṃ śaṃbhuṃ prayayau sa gaṇeśvaraḥ .. 54 ..
4.116.d:
कार्तिकः प्रययौ गेहमूषागेहं स्मरात्मजः ।
सर्व निवेदितुं शंभुं प्रययौ स गणेश्वरः ॥ 54 ॥
4.116.m: Kārtika went home; the son of Smara went to Uṣā's house; / and Gaṇeśvara went to inform Śambhu of everything.

4.116.s:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nārādanāo bāṇayuo
ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 116 ..
4.116.d:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारादनाओ बाणयुओ
षोडशाधिकशततमोऽध्यायः ॥ 116 ॥
4.116.m: Thus ends the one hundred and sixteenth chapter, on the battle of Bāṇa, in the dialogue between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa, in the latter section of the Śrī-Kṛṣṇa-janma-khaṇḍa, in the great Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa.

4.117.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca
gaṇeśastu śivasthānaṃ gatvā natvā maheśvaram .
sarva vijñāpayāmāsa krameṇa ca pṛthakpṛthak .. 1 ..
4.117.d:
नारायण उवाच
गणेशस्तु शिवस्थानं गत्वा नत्वा महेश्वरम् ।
सर्व विज्ञापयामास क्रमेण च पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 1 ॥

4.117.s:
bāṇāniruddhayoryuddhaṃ subhadranidhanaṃ tathā .
skandāniruddhayoryuddhamaniruddhasya vikramam .. 2 ..
4.117.d:
बाणानिरुद्धयोर्युद्धं सुभद्रनिधनं तथा ।
स्कन्दानिरुद्धयोर्युद्धमनिरुद्धस्य विक्रमम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.117.m: the battle between Bāṇa and Aniruddha, the death of Subhadra, / the battle between Skanda and Aniruddha, and the valour of Aniruddha.

4.117.s:
gaṇeśavacanaṃ śrutvā prahasya bhagavānbhavaḥ .
uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā suguptaṃ vedasaṃmatam .. 3 ..
4.117.d:
गणेशवचनं श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य भगवान्भवः ।
उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा सुगुप्तं वेदसंमतम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.117.m: Hearing Gaṇeśa's words, the blessed Bhava smiled / and spoke in gentle words what is deeply secret and agreed by the Veda.

4.117.s:
mahādeva uvāca
gaṇeśvara mahābhāga śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama .
hitaṃ tathyaṃ nītisāraṃ pariṇāmasukhāvaham .. 4 ..
4.117.d:
महादेव उवाच
गणेश्वर महाभाग श्रूयतां वचनं मम ।
हितं तथ्यं नीतिसारं परिणामसुखावहम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.117.m: Mahādeva said: / O fortunate Gaṇeśvara, listen to my words, / which are beneficial, true, the essence of wisdom, and productive of happiness in the end.

4.117.s:
asaṃkhyaviśvasaṃghaṃ ca sarva kṛṣṇātmajaṃ sutam .
kṛṣṇaṃ jānīhi yatkāryaṃ kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam .. 5 ..
4.117.d:
असंख्यविश्वसंघं च सर्व कृष्णात्मजं सुतम् ।
कृष्णं जानीहि यत्कार्यं कारणानां च कारणम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.117.m: The multitude of countless universes is entirely the offspring born of Kṛṣṇa; / know Kṛṣṇa as that which is the effect, and the cause of causes.

4.117.s:
brahmāditṛṇaparyantaṃ jagatmarva gaṇeśvara .
nibodha satyaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca bhagavantaṃ sanātanam .. 6 ..
4.117.d:
ब्रह्मादितृणपर्यन्तं जगत्मर्व गणेश्वर ।
निबोध सत्यं कृष्णं च भगवन्तं सनातनम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.117.m: From Brahmā down to a blade of grass, the whole universe, O Gaṇeśvara— / understand truly that it is Kṛṣṇa, the eternal Lord:

4.117.s:
goloke dvibhujaṃ śāntaṃ rādhākāntaṃ manoharam .
śiśurūpaṃ gopaveṣaṃ gopaveṣaṃ paripūrṇatamaṃ prabhum .. 7 ..
4.117.d:
गोलोके द्विभुजं शान्तं राधाकान्तं मनोहरम् ।
शिशुरूपं गोपवेषं गोपवेषं परिपूर्णतमं प्रभुम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.117.m: in Goloka, two-armed, peaceful, the beloved of Rādhā, enchanting, / having the form of a child, dressed as a cowherd, the most perfect Lord,

4.117.s:
gopībhirgopanikaraiḥ sahitaṃ kāmadhenubhiḥ .
puṇye vṛndāvane ramye sundare rāsamaṇḍale .. 8 ..
4.117.d:
गोपीभिर्गोपनिकरैः सहितं कामधेनुभिः ।
पुण्ये वृन्दावने रम्ये सुन्दरे रासमण्डले ॥ 8 ॥
4.117.m: accompanied by the gopīs, by herds of cowherds, and by wish-fulfilling cows, / in holy Vṛndāvana, delightful and beautiful, in the circle of the rāsa-dance,

4.117.s:
carantaṃ muralīhastaṃ brahmeśaśeṣavanditam .
śataśṛṅgai ca śaileśe vaṭamūle nirākule .. 9 ..
4.117.d:
चरन्तं मुरलीहस्तं ब्रह्मेशशेषवन्दितम् ।
शतशृङ्गै च शैलेशे वटमूले निराकुले ॥ 9 ॥
4.117.m: wandering with flute in hand, praised by Brahmā, Īśa, and Śeṣa, / on the hundred-peaked king of mountains, at the foot of the banyan tree, untroubled,

4.117.s:
goṣṭhe bhāṇḍīranikaṭe nirmale virajātaṭe .
navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ śobhitaṃ pītavāsasā .. 10 ..
4.117.d:
गोष्ठे भाण्डीरनिकटे निर्मले विरजातटे ।
नवीननीरदश्यामं शोभितं पीतवाससा ॥ 10 ॥
4.117.m: in the cowpen, near Bhāṇḍīra, on the pure bank of the Virajā, / dark as a fresh rain-cloud, adorned with yellow garments,

4.117.s:
yathā navaṃ ghanaughaṃ ca saudāminthā virājitam .
āvirbhāvaśca teṣāṃ vai goloke rāsamaṇḍale .. 11 ..
4.117.d:
यथा नवं घनौघं च सौदामिन्था विराजितम् ।
आविर्भावश्च तेषां वै गोलोके रासमण्डले ॥ 11 ॥
4.117.m: just like a fresh bank of clouds illumined by lightning. / Their manifestation indeed is in Goloka, in the circle of the rāsa-dance.

4.117.s:
tāvanto gokule ramye puṇye vṛndāvane vane .
sarve cāṃśakalāḥ puṃsaḥkṛṣṇastu bhagavānsvayam .. 12 ..
4.117.d:
तावन्तो गोकुले रम्ये पुण्ये वृन्दावने वने ।
सर्वे चांशकलाः पुंसःकृष्णस्तु भगवान्स्वयम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.117.m: So many are they in lovely Gokula, in the sacred forest of Vṛndāvana; / all are portions and parts of the Puruṣa, but Kṛṣṇa is the Lord Himself.

4.117.s:
paripūrṇatamaḥ kāmo brahmaśāpātsvavismṛtaḥ .
tasya putro'niruddhaśca mahābalaparākramaḥ .. 13 ..
4.117.d:
परिपूर्णतमः कामो ब्रह्मशापात्स्वविस्मृतः ।
तस्य पुत्रोऽनिरुद्धश्च महाबलपराक्रमः ॥ 13 ॥
4.117.m: Fully complete, Kāma, having forgotten himself through the curse of a brahmin, / had a son, Aniruddha, of great strength and valour.

4.117.s:
mayā prasthāpitaḥ skando mahāyuddhe sudāruṇe .
mṛto bāṇaśca saṃgrāme tena skandena rakṣitaḥ .. 14 ..
4.117.d:
मया प्रस्थापितः स्कन्दो महायुद्धे सुदारुणे ।
मृतो बाणश्च संग्रामे तेन स्कन्देन रक्षितः ॥ 14 ॥
4.117.m: Skanda was dispatched by me into the very terrible, great battle; / and Bāṇa, [nearly] killed in battle, was protected by that Skanda.

4.117.s:
skandāniruddhayoryuddhe samatvaṃ tu gaṇeśvara .
aṣṭau ca bhairavāḥ sarve rudrāścaikādaśaiva te .. 15 ..
4.117.d:
स्कन्दानिरुद्धयोर्युद्धे समत्वं तु गणेश्वर ।
अष्टौ च भैरवाः सर्वे रुद्राश्चैकादशैव ते ॥ 15 ॥
4.117.m: In the battle between Skanda and Aniruddha, however, there was an equality, O Gaṇeśvara. / And all the eight Bhairavas, and the eleven Rudras,

4.117.s:
aṣṭau ca vasavaścaite devāḥ śakrādayastathā .
tathaiva dvādaśādityāḥ sarve daityeśvarāstathā .. 16 ..
4.117.d:
अष्टौ च वसवश्चैते देवाः शक्रादयस्तथा ।
तथैव द्वादशादित्याः सर्वे दैत्येश्वरास्तथा ॥ 16 ॥
4.117.m: and these eight Vasus, the gods headed by Śakra, / likewise the twelve Ādityas, and all the chiefs of the Daityas,

4.117.s:
devānāmagraṇīḥ skando bāṇaśca sagaṇastathā .
sarve te cāniruddhaṃ ca saṃgrāme jetumakṣamāḥ .. 17 ..
4.117.d:
देवानामग्रणीः स्कन्दो बाणश्च सगणस्तथा ।
सर्वे ते चानिरुद्धं च संग्रामे जेतुमक्षमाः ॥ 17 ॥
4.117.m: the leader of the gods Skanda, and Bāṇa along with his attendants— / all of them were unable to defeat Aniruddha in battle.

4.117.s:
aniruddhaḥ svayaṃ brahmā pradyumnaḥ kāma eva ca .
baladevaḥ svayaṃ śeṣaḥ kṛṣṇaśca prakṛteḥ paraḥ .. 18 ..
4.117.d:
अनिरुद्धः स्वयं ब्रह्मा प्रद्युम्नः काम एव च ।
बलदेवः स्वयं शेषः कृष्णश्च प्रकृतेः परः ॥ 18 ॥
4.117.m: Aniruddha is Brahmā himself, and Pradyumna is Kāma; / Baladeva is Śeṣa himself, and Kṛṣṇa is beyond Prakṛti.

4.117.s:
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ bāṇaṃ rakṣa gaṇeśvara .
bhavāñśubhasvarūpaśca vighnakhaṇḍanakārakaḥ .. 19 ..
4.117.d:
एतत्ते कथितं सर्वं बाणं रक्ष गणेश्वर ।
भवाञ्शुभस्वरूपश्च विघ्नखण्डनकारकः ॥ 19 ॥
4.117.m: All this has been told to you: protect Bāṇa, O Gaṇeśvara. / You are auspicious in nature and the remover of obstacles.

4.117.s:
ārādāyāsyati harirgṛhītvā ca sudarśanam .
avyarthamastrapravaraṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham .. 20 ..
4.117.d:
आरादायास्यति हरिर्गृहीत्वा च सुदर्शनम् ।
अव्यर्थमस्त्रप्रवरं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् ॥ 20 ॥
4.117.m: From nearby Hari will arrive, having taken up the Sudarśana, / the unfailing, foremost of weapons, equal in splendour to ten million suns.

4.117.s:
iti śrībrahmao mahāo śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhao uttao nāradanāo bāṇayuddhe
śivalambodarasaṃo saptadaśādhikaśātatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 117 ..
4.117.d:
इति श्रीब्रह्मओ महाओ श्रीकृष्णजन्मखओ उत्तओ नारदनाओ बाणयुद्धे
शिवलम्बोदरसंओ सप्तदशाधिकशाततमोऽध्यायः ॥ 117 ॥
4.117.m: Thus ends the hundred and seventeenth chapter, entitled 'The Conversation of Śiva and Lambodara in the Battle with Bāṇa', in the Uttarakhaṇḍa of the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa in the great Brahmavaivarta Purāṇa, in the dialogue between Nārada and Nārāyaṇa.

4.118.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca
gaṇeśaṃ bodhayitvā tu śaṃbhuramyantaraṃ yayau .
tatra siṃhāsane ramye durgā durgatināśinī .. 1 ..
4.118.d:
नारायण उवाच
गणेशं बोधयित्वा तु शंभुरम्यन्तरं ययौ ।
तत्र सिंहासने रम्ये दुर्गा दुर्गतिनाशिनी ॥ 1 ॥

4.118.s:
bhairavī bhadrakālī ca ugracaṇḍā ca koṭarī .
tāḥ samutthāya sahasā praṇemurjagadīśvam .. 2 ..
4.118.d:
भैरवी भद्रकाली च उग्रचण्डा च कोटरी ।
ताः समुत्थाय सहसा प्रणेमुर्जगदीश्वम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.118.m: along with Bhairavī, Bhadrakālī, Ugracaṇḍā, and Koṭarī. / Rising up at once, they bowed to the Lord of the Universe.

4.118.s:
tatrā''yayau gaṇeśaśca kārtikeyaśca vīryavān .
bāṇaśca vīrabhadraśca svayaṃ nandī sunandakaḥ .. 3 ..
4.118.d:
तत्रा'ऽययौ गणेशश्च कार्तिकेयश्च वीर्यवान् ।
बाणश्च वीरभद्रश्च स्वयं नन्दी सुनन्दकः ॥ 3 ॥
4.118.m: There came Gaṇeśa and the heroic Kārtikeya, / Bāṇa, Vīrabhadra, Nandī himself, and Sunandaka,

4.118.s:
mahākālo mahāmantrī hyathāṣṭauṃ bhairavāstathā .
siddhendrāścāpi yogīndrā rudrāścaikādaśaiva te .. 4 ..
4.118.d:
महाकालो महामन्त्री ह्यथाष्टौं भैरवास्तथा ।
सिद्धेन्द्राश्चापि योगीन्द्रा रुद्राश्चैकादशैव ते ॥ 4 ॥
4.118.m: Mahākāla, the chief minister, and likewise the eight Bhairavas, / the chiefs of the Siddhas and chiefs of Yogins, and the eleven Rudras.

4.118.s:
etasminnantare tatra maṇibhadraḥ samāyayau .
sihadvāre svayaṃ dvārī tabhīśvaramuvāca saḥ .. 5 ..
4.118.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र मणिभद्रः समाययौ ।
सिहद्वारे स्वयं द्वारी तभीश्वरमुवाच सः ॥ 5 ॥
4.118.m: In the meantime, Maṇibhadra arrived there; / he, the doorkeeper at the lion-gate, spoke to the Lord:

4.118.s:
maṇibhadra uvāca
asaṃkhyāni ca sainyāni yādavānāṃ maheśvara .
baladevaśca pradyumnaḥ sāmbaśca sātyakistathā .. 6 ..
4.118.d:
मणिभद्र उवाच
असंख्यानि च सैन्यानि यादवानां महेश्वर ।
बलदेवश्च प्रद्युम्नः साम्बश्च सात्यकिस्तथा ॥ 6 ॥
4.118.m:
Maṇibhadra said:
There are innumerable armies of the Yādavas, O Maheśvara: / Baladeva, Pradyumna, Sāmba, and Sātyaki,

4.118.s:
rājā mahograsenaśca bhīmaśca svayamarjunaḥ .
akrūnaścodyavaścaiva jayantaḥ śakranandanaḥ .. 7 ..
4.118.d:
राजा महोग्रसेनश्च भीमश्च स्वयमर्जुनः ।
अक्रूनश्चोद्यवश्चैव जयन्तः शक्रनन्दनः ॥ 7 ॥
4.118.m: the great king Ugrasena, Bhīma, Arjuna himself, / Akrūra, Uddhava, and Jayanta the son of Śakra;

4.118.s:
ratnenadrasāranirmāṇarathendre sumanohare .
vidhervidhātā bhagavāñchrīkṛṣṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ .. 8 ..
4.118.d:
रत्नेनद्रसारनिर्माणरथेन्द्रे सुमनोहरे ।
विधेर्विधाता भगवाञ्छ्रीकृष्णः परमेश्वरः ॥ 8 ॥
4.118.m: and in an exceedingly charming, foremost chariot made of the essence of the best of gems, / the Lord, the maker of destiny, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Lord,

4.118.s:
saptabhiḥ pārṣadaigoṃpaiḥ sevitaḥ śvetayāmaraiḥ .
kandarpakoṭilīlābho vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ .. 9 ..
4.118.d:
सप्तभिः पार्षदैगोंपैः सेवितः श्वेतयामरैः ।
कन्दर्पकोटिलीलाभो वनमालाविभूषितः ॥ 9 ॥
4.118.m: attended by seven attendant cowherds with white chowries, / possessing the splendour of ten million Kamas in play, adorned with a garland of forest flowers.

4.118.s:
dadhāra cakramatulaṃ koṭisūryasamaprabham .
gadāṃ kaumodakīṃ śūlamavyarthaṃ saṃnidhāya ca .. 10 ..
4.118.d:
दधार चक्रमतुलं कोटिसूर्यसमप्रभम् ।
गदां कौमोदकीं शूलमव्यर्थं संनिधाय च ॥ 10 ॥
4.118.m: He bore the peerless discus equal in splendour to ten million suns, / and, having placed near him the club Kaumodakī and the unfailing trident,

4.118.s:
rathamadhye mahāśaṅkhaṃ viśvasaṃhārakāraṇam .
mahārathānāṃ lakṣaiśca rathānāṃ ca trikoṭibhiḥ .. 11 ..
4.118.d:
रथमध्ये महाशङ्खं विश्वसंहारकारणम् ।
महारथानां लक्षैश्च रथानां च त्रिकोटिभिः ॥ 11 ॥
4.118.m: and within the chariot the great conch that causes the destruction of the universe, / [accompanied] by a hundred thousand great charioteers and thirty million chariots,

4.118.s:
trikoṭibhirgajendrāṇāṃ mallānāṃ ca trikoṭimiḥ .
śatakoṭibhiraśvānāṃ carmiṇāṃ taccaturguṇaiḥ .. 12 ..
4.118.d:
त्रिकोटिभिर्गजेन्द्राणां मल्लानां च त्रिकोटिमिः ।
शतकोटिभिरश्वानां चर्मिणां तच्चतुर्गुणैः ॥ 12 ॥
4.118.m: by thirty million noble elephants, and thirty million wrestlers, / by one billion horses, by four times as many shield-bearers,

4.118.s:
khaḍgināṃ tatsaptaguṇairdviguṇaistaddhanuṣmatām .
ebhiḥ sārdha ca tvaritamāyayau śoṇitaṃ puram .. 13 ..
4.118.d:
खड्गिनां तत्सप्तगुणैर्द्विगुणैस्तद्धनुष्मताम् ।
एभिः सार्ध च त्वरितमाययौ शोणितं पुरम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.118.m: by seven times as many swordsmen, and by twice as many bowmen; / along with these, he swiftly came to the city of Śoṇita.

4.118.s:
parito veṣṭayāmāsa laṅkāṃ dāśarathiryathā .
sahasratālamānāṃ ca jvaladagniśikhojjvalām .. 14 ..
4.118.d:
परितो वेष्टयामास लङ्कां दाशरथिर्यथा ।
सहस्रतालमानां च ज्वलदग्निशिखोज्ज्वलाम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.118.m: He surrounded it all around, just as the son of Daśaratha surrounded Laṅkā. / Rising a thousand palm-trees high and blazing with glowing flames of fire,

4.118.s:
ūrdhve ca parikhāyuktāṃ durlaṅdhyāmasuraiḥ suraiḥ .
svargagaṅgāmburāśīnāṃ samūhairvṛṣṭibhistathā .. 15 ..
4.118.d:
ऊर्ध्वे च परिखायुक्तां दुर्लङ्ध्यामसुरैः सुरैः ।
स्वर्गगङ्गाम्बुराशीनां समूहैर्वृष्टिभिस्तथा ॥ 15 ॥
4.118.m: and with a moat overhead, impassable to Asuras and gods, / with masses of waters from the heavenly Gaṅgā and with showers,

4.118.s:
pakṣīndro garuḍaḥ sākṣānnirvāṇaṃ ca cakāra saḥ .
maṇīndrasāranirmāṇaṃ prākārābhraṃlihaṃ puram .. 16 ..
4.118.d:
पक्षीन्द्रो गरुडः साक्षान्निर्वाणं च चकार सः ।
मणीन्द्रसारनिर्माणं प्राकाराभ्रंलिहं पुरम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.118.m: Garuḍa, the king of birds in visible form, extinguished it. / Baladeva, [approaching] the city made of the essence of best gems, whose ramparts scraped the clouds,

4.118.s:
babhañja lakṣaṃ mallānāṃ baladevaśca lāṅgalaiḥ .
udyānānāṃ trilakṣaṃ ca cakārotpāṭanaṃ prabho .. 17 ..
4.118.d:
बभञ्ज लक्षं मल्लानां बलदेवश्च लाङ्गलैः ।
उद्यानानां त्रिलक्षं च चकारोत्पाटनं प्रभो ॥ 17 ॥
4.118.m: crushed a hundred thousand wrestlers with his plow, / and uprooted three hundred thousand gardens, O Lord.

4.118.s:
praviveśa mahādvāraṃ dvārapālānnipatya ca .
evaṃ śrutvā mahādevaścovāca surasaṃsadi .. 18 ..
4.118.d:
प्रविवेश महाद्वारं द्वारपालान्निपत्य च ।
एवं श्रुत्वा महादेवश्चोवाच सुरसंसदि ॥ 18 ॥
4.118.m: Having struck down the gatekeepers, he entered the great gate. / Having heard this, Mahādeva spoke in the assembly of the gods

4.118.s:
pārvatī bhadrakālī ca skandaṃ gaṇapatiṃ tathā .
aṣṭau ca bhairavāṃścaiva rudrāśca vīrabhadrakam
mahākālaṃ nandinaṃ ca sarvānsenāpatīnnava .. 19 ..
4.118.d:
पार्वती भद्रकाली च स्कन्दं गणपतिं तथा ।
अष्टौ च भैरवांश्चैव रुद्राश्च वीरभद्रकम्
महाकालं नन्दिनं च सर्वान्सेनापतीन्नव ॥ 19 ॥
4.118.m: to Pārvatī, Bhadrakālī, Skanda, and Gaṇapati, / and the eight Bhairavas, the Rudras, Vīrabhadra, / Mahākāla, Nandin, and all the nine commanders of the army.

4.118.s:
mahādeva uvāca
golokanātho bhagavāṃścakrapāṇiḥ samāgataḥ .
viśvaughaṃ bhaṅktumīśo yaḥ kṣaṇena nagaraṃ ca kim .. 20 ..
4.118.d:
महादेव उवाच
गोलोकनाथो भगवांश्चक्रपाणिः समागतः ।
विश्वौघं भङ्क्तुमीशो यः क्षणेन नगरं च किम् ॥ 20 ॥
4.118.m:
Mahādeva said:
The Lord of Goloka, the wielder of the discus, has arrived, / who is capable of destroying the multitude of universes in an instant—what of a city?

4.118.s:
sarvopāyaiśca sarve te bāṇaṃ rakṣantu yatnataḥ .
bāṇo gacchatu saṃgrāmaṃ smṛtvā lambodaraṃ param .. 21 ..
4.118.d:
सर्वोपायैश्च सर्वे ते बाणं रक्षन्तु यत्नतः ।
बाणो गच्छतु संग्रामं स्मृत्वा लम्बोदरं परम् ॥ 21 ॥
4.118.m: By all means, let them all protect Bāṇa with diligence. / Let Bāṇa go to the battle, having remembered supreme Lambodara.

4.118.s:
bāṇasya dakṣiṇo skandaḥ purataśca gaṇeśvaraḥ .
vāme ca bhairavā rudrāḥ svayaṃ nandī sahārathaḥ .. 22 ..
4.118.d:
बाणस्य दक्षिणो स्कन्दः पुरतश्च गणेश्वरः ।
वामे च भैरवा रुद्राः स्वयं नन्दी सहारथः ॥ 22 ॥
4.118.m: On Bāṇa's right is Skanda, and in front is Gaṇeśvara; / on the left are the Bhairavas, the Rudras, and Nandī himself with his chariot,

4.118.s:
mahākālo vīrabhadro ye cānyo sainikāstathā .
ūrdhve durgā bhadrakālī hyagraṇḍā ca koṭarī .. 23 ..
4.118.d:
महाकालो वीरभद्रो ये चान्यो सैनिकास्तथा ।
ऊर्ध्वे दुर्गा भद्रकाली ह्यग्रण्डा च कोटरी ॥ 23 ॥
4.118.m: Mahākāla, Vīrabhadra, and whatever other soldiers there are; / above are Durgā, Bhadrakālī, Ugracaṇḍā, and Koṭarī.

4.118.s:
bāṇaṃ rakṣa mahābhāge durge durgatināśini .
kṛṣṇasya bhavatī śaktistena nārāyaṇī smṛtā .. 24 ..
4.118.d:
बाणं रक्ष महाभागे दुर्गे दुर्गतिनाशिनि ।
कृष्णस्य भवती शक्तिस्तेन नारायणी स्मृता ॥ 24 ॥
4.118.m: Protect Bāṇa, O highly fortunate Durgā, destroyer of distress! / You are Kṛṣṇa's potency; therefore you are remembered as Nārāyaṇī.

4.118.s:
viṣṇumāye jaganmātaḥ sarvamaṅgalamaṅgale .
avyarthāccakrasāracca rakṣa bāṇaṃ sudarśanāt .. 25 ..
4.118.d:
विष्णुमाये जगन्मातः सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गले ।
अव्यर्थाच्चक्रसारच्च रक्ष बाणं सुदर्शनात् ॥ 25 ॥
4.118.m: O Viṣṇumāyā, Mother of the Universe, auspiciousness of all that is auspicious! / Protect Bāṇa from the unfailing, foremost discus, from the Sudarśana.

4.118.s:
bāṇaḥ priyo me sarvemyo gaṇeśātkārtikādapi .
bāṇamūrdhni karaṃ dhehi pādābjarajasā saha .. 26 ..
4.118.d:
बाणः प्रियो मे सर्वेम्यो गणेशात्कार्तिकादपि ।
बाणमूर्ध्नि करं धेहि पादाब्जरजसा सह ॥ 26 ॥
4.118.m: Bāṇa is dearer to me than all, even more than Gaṇeśa and Kārtika. / Place your hand upon Bāṇa's head along with the dust of your lotus feet.

4.118.s:
śivasya vacanaṃ śrutvā durgā durgatināśinī .
prahasyovāca madhuraṃ yāthārthyaṃ samayocitam .. 27 ..
4.118.d:
शिवस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा दुर्गा दुर्गतिनाशिनी ।
प्रहस्योवाच मधुरं याथार्थ्यं समयोचितम् ॥ 27 ॥
4.118.m: Having heard Śiva's words, Durgā, the destroyer of distress, / smiled and spoke sweet truth, suited to the occasion.

4.118.s:
pārvatyuvāca
maṇiratnādikaṃ yadyanmuktāmāṇikyahīrakam .
sarvasvaṃ kanyakāmūṣāṃ ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām .. 28 ..
4.118.d:
पार्वत्युवाच
मणिरत्नादिकं यद्यन्मुक्तामाणिक्यहीरकम् ।
सर्वस्वं कन्यकामूषां रत्नभूषणभूषिताम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.118.m:
Pārvatī said:
Whatever gems, jewels, pearls, rubies, and diamonds [there are], / all possessions, along with the maiden Uṣā adorned with jewel ornaments,

4.118.s:
ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣāḍhyamaniruddhaṃ paraṃ varam .
puraskṛtya dehi bāṇa kṛṣṇāya paramātmane .. 29 ..
4.118.d:
रत्नभूषणभूषाढ्यमनिरुद्धं परं वरम् ।
पुरस्कृत्य देहि बाण कृष्णाय परमात्मने ॥ 29 ॥
4.118.m: and having placed foremost Aniruddha, the supreme bridegroom, rich with gem ornaments, / give them, O Bāṇa, to Kṛṣṇa, the Paramātman.

4.118.s:
rājyaṃ kuruṣva nirvighnaṃ kiṃ yuddhamātmanā saha .
yasmingate gatāḥ prāṇāḥ ka jīvaścaindriyaiḥ saha .
śaktiścāhaṃ mano brahmā svayaṃ jñānātmakaṃ śivaḥ .. 30 ..
4.118.d:
राज्यं कुरुष्व निर्विघ्नं किं युद्धमात्मना सह ।
यस्मिन्गते गताः प्राणाः क जीवश्चैन्द्रियैः सह ।
शक्तिश्चाहं मनो ब्रह्मा स्वयं ज्ञानात्मकं शिवः ॥ 30 ॥
4.118.m: Rule your kingdom without obstacles; why make war with the Self? / When he departs, the vital breaths depart; what is the individual soul with the senses? / I am the power, Brahmā is the mind, and Śiva is knowledge itself.

4.118.s:
sadyaḥ patati dehaśca śivaṃ tyaktvā śavo bhavet .
ko vā tiṣṭhati saṃgrāme cakrasya tejasā śiva .. 31 ..
4.118.d:
सद्यः पतति देहश्च शिवं त्यक्त्वा शवो भवेत् ।
को वा तिष्ठति संग्रामे चक्रस्य तेजसा शिव ॥ 31 ॥
4.118.m: Immediately the body falls, and leaving Śiva, it becomes a corpse. / Who indeed can stand in battle before the splendour of the discus, O Śiva?

4.118.s:
nā''tmā''kāśo bāṇaviddho yuddhaṃ kiṃ svātmanā saha .
paramātmā ca sarveṣāṃ bhaktānugrahavigrahaḥ .. 32 ..
4.118.d:
ना'ऽत्मा'ऽकाशो बाणविद्धो युद्धं किं स्वात्मना सह ।
परमात्मा च सर्वेषां भक्तानुग्रहविग्रहः ॥ 32 ॥
4.118.m: The space of the Self is not pierced by arrows; why make war with one's own Self? / He is the Paramātman of all, taking form out of grace to devotees.

4.118.s:
nityaḥ satyo hi kṛṣṇaśca paribūrṇatamaḥ prabhuḥ .
gaṇeśaḥ kārtikeyaśca bhavānapi tayoḥ paraḥ .. 33 ..
4.118.d:
नित्यः सत्यो हि कृष्णश्च परिबूर्णतमः प्रभुः ।
गणेशः कार्तिकेयश्च भवानपि तयोः परः ॥ 33 ॥
4.118.m: Eternal and real indeed is Kṛṣṇa, the most complete Lord. / Gaṇeśa, Kārtikeya, and even you are lower than Him.

4.118.s:
kiṃkareṣu priyo bāṇo na hi kṛṣṇātparaḥ priyaḥ .
vaikuṇṭhe'haṃ mahālakṣmīrgoloke rādhikā svayam .. 34 ..
4.118.d:
किंकरेषु प्रियो बाणो न हि कृष्णात्परः प्रियः ।
वैकुण्ठेऽहं महालक्ष्मीर्गोलोके राधिका स्वयम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.118.m: Among servants, Bāṇa is dear, but none is dearer than Kṛṣṇa. / In Vaikuṇṭha I am Mahālakṣmī; in Goloka, Rādhikā myself.

4.118.s:
śivā'haṃ śivaloke'pi brahmaloke sarasvatī .
ahaṃ nihatya daityāṃśca dakṣakanyā satī purā .. 35 ..
4.118.d:
शिवाऽहं शिवलोकेऽपि ब्रह्मलोके सरस्वती ।
अहं निहत्य दैत्यांश्च दक्षकन्या सती पुरा ॥ 35 ॥
4.118.m: I am Śivā in Śivaloka, and Sarasvatī in Brahmaloka. / In ancient times, having slain the Daityas, I was Satī, the daughter of Dakṣa;

4.118.s:
tvannindayā tyaktadehā sā cāhaṃ śailakanyakā .
raktabījasya yuddhe ca kānī ca mūrtibhedataḥ .. 36 ..
4.118.d:
त्वन्निन्दया त्यक्तदेहा सा चाहं शैलकन्यका ।
रक्तबीजस्य युद्धे च कानी च मूर्तिभेदतः ॥ 36 ॥
4.118.m: having abandoned my body on account of insult to you, I became the daughter of the mountain. / And in the battle with Raktabīja, through difference of forms, I was Kālī;

4.118.s:
sāvitrī vedamātā'haṃ sītā janakakanyakā .
rukmiṇī dvāravatyāṃ ca bhārate bhīṣmakanyakā .. 37 ..
4.118.d:
सावित्री वेदमाताऽहं सीता जनककन्यका ।
रुक्मिणी द्वारवत्यां च भारते भीष्मकन्यका ॥ 37 ॥
4.118.m: I am Sāvitrī, mother of the Vedas; Sītā, daughter of Janaka; / and Rukmiṇī in Dvāravatī, the daughter of Bhīṣmaka in Bhārata;

4.118.s:
sudāmnaḥ śāpato daivādvṛṣabhānasutā'dhunā .
dharmapatnī ca kṛṣṇasya puṇye vṛndāvane vane .. 38 ..
4.118.d:
सुदाम्नः शापतो दैवाद्वृषभानसुताऽधुना ।
